“To see everyone as a potential traitor, to be cautious of them as they would seem like an enemy who will stab you on your back… But you would still listen to my words like a prophecy from God, into some kid like that.”
This woman. She had gone mad for good.
“I came to Celestial Dragon because I saw your future. Insanity-tainted, the best hunter in human history, do you understand? I tried to support you and be on your side, for you not to be faltered from that path. For you to escape from being uncontrolled to being the best hunter, to be your spiritual support. And I’ll make a colleague who fights for the world with me.”
I gritted my teeth. Several scenes from the memory of the original Seo Jin-Wook passed in my mind. It was all nonsense. I let out a cry immediately after, and some anger was mixed in, something that might not be entirely mine.
“You came to Celestial Dragon to support me? Bullshit. Then why did you sit by and watch over Seo Gyu-Cheol?”
And what was the purpose of the curse? The curse of leeching on the original Seo Jin-Wook fed on his anger. Seo Jin-Wook’s condition might have been better if he had been away from Seo Gyu-Cheol. Han-Seol replied in a tone that made it seem like my question was self-explanatory.
“Isn’t that obvious? So that Seo Gyu-Cheol and the people around you will make you feel hopeless, angry, and that you have nobody on your side. Then you will become more reliant on me.”
Upon hearing this, the magic sword began to mumble. ‘A good Hunter that escaped from being uncontrolled? So, in the end, that bitch wanted to make a chess pawn that only she could control. What’s the relationship between you two again?’
“But the plan has changed. I’ll take your life. It’s for a great cause. I’m sorry, Jin-Wook.”
Just then, another dungeon message rang out.
– Part of the weakened boundary of stage 3 of the dungeon has collapsed.
– Cause of boundary collapse: external entry.
It was the worst timing. Instead of listening more, I swung the sword at Han-Seol.
*
Crossing the boundaries of the dungeon was a being that had lived for a long time. Until then, in the dimension that resided, it had never been called with a proper noun. Everyone called it the emperor. The emperor was always looking for an opportunity to go beyond the dungeon’s boundaries to another level.
Back in the days, the life in the dimension that he reigned wasn’t bad either since every resident swore their loyalty to him. If it was desired, there was no reason for it to be impossible. If it was deemed necessary, it was put into action right away. It was literally like a living god. The decisive reason why the situation deteriorated was that its people… its species were unreasonably weak. The emperor murmured.
‘Too many have died.’
The tutorial was stopped at that dimension. Due to the system’s judgment, the minimum number of Awakened and civilized races that could continue was not secured. They couldn’t even climb the Tower of Choice. The tutorial stopped, and the dungeon no longer opened, but the opened dungeon did not close again. So the emperor decided to abandon this dimension. It had been a long time since he changed his race.
‘I could smell it.’
The thick fog did not cloud the emperor’s eyes. He had been living for a very long time now, and he had some tricks up his sleeves to counter this situation. He detected the surroundings without a sweat.
‘It’s best to find an Awakened that is fatigued from using almost all of its Mana. There must be a tired one right after the attack!’
What he was looking for was a weakened Awakened. And soon, he saw the most suitable target which met his eyes. Not only that, it had weakened, but the body had no way to fight back.
‘It’s a dead body. It’s incredibly fresh. It’s the best!’
A body was lying on the floor, a decapitated corpse. As the ends of all Awakened were the same, Mana core had already evaporated and disappeared. However, all it took was the traces of once having a core. This was so that it could change it to the spot. Furthermore…
‘This garment is from a highly developed civilization.’
Next, he looked inside the cold skin. He let out an exclamation.
‘A much better body than these scumbags around! A superior race!’
He unknowingly smiled. ‘The time has finally come to throw away this old body.’
As soon as he made up his mind, a light fog-like thing shot out of the emperor’s mouth. If Seo Jin-Wook had seen it, he would have recognized that substances similar to Mana cores were distributed in the form of gases in the organic fog. It was common for the Mana core form to change when the species changed. The mist seeped into the cut surface on the throat of the body, lying on the floor.
Then…
The body of an alien race that functioned as the emperor’s body until now fell on the floor. The body, which could be called the real emperor, was now infiltrated inside the decapitated body.
‘Starting with the core!’
A fog-shaped core found its place in the heart of the body. Then, the core was newly formed along the remaining traces. Soon, the cold and hardened heart started to beat again. Mana began to fill her body as it made different from the previous owner. The emperor, who took control of the body, calmly analyzed the gene sequence.
‘It may have died here alone, but you may have been a fellow species who witnessed it. I’ll have a problem if I get back out alive. I’d better change my appearance moderately.’
However, it was unclear how many changes should be made because it was not yet fully familiar with the species. A drastic change could have made it beyond their cognizance of kinship.
‘Let’s keep the changes to a minimum.’
The information stored in the gene sequence decides to retain their hair, eye color, and skin color intact as it did that.
Gooooooooooooooooooo!
The cutthroat swells up flesh, veins, nerves, and bones. Soon, the sliced surface disappeared neatly, and the blown-up head was formed again. The body that rose from its seat began to breathe.
‘Good, very good.’
A perfect regeneration. It looked around and smiled satisfactorily. As she returned to life, she looked across the mist in a face that looked like hers, but still a little different.

chapters.title: Chapter 52
chapters.content:
Siheung 8 Dungeon (5)
I killed the last chimera of stage three and got the dungeon key and extra compensation ready for the first place as a contributor.
I was quite far away from Nicole and the portal.
Han-Seol told me by telepathy. Nicole’s on the verge of a Mana shock, so she can’t use her [All-Seeing Light] for a while, so to just stand-by where I was. She said that she would follow Mana’s string created by [Battlefield Command] to pick me up.
‘I was going to target Han-Seol right after the Clear anyways.’
Han-Seol would have similar thoughts if she were targeting me.
Nicole really could be in bad shape because of Mana consumption, or Han-Seol could already hold her down.
She must be coming to me since she’s sure that she can avoid Nicole’s eyes.
‘I don’t necessarily have to fight on this outskirts.’
Instead of waiting as I was, I quickly moved in the direction of Han-Seol along the string of Mana that I could see.
Either way, whether Nicole was naturally incapacitated or Han-Seol incapacitated her by her hands, Han-Seol would be coming from where Nicole is, which is near the portal.
In preparation for the possibility of being isolated in the fog immediately after the battle with Han-Seol, I decided that it would be advantageous to fight with the portal as near as possible.
So Han-Seol would have met me much earlier than she had expected.
After such encounters, I couldn’t help but think of someone when I saw the madness in the eyes of Han-Seol.
‘It’s similar to Park Chang-Hee’s.’
Park Chang-Hee showed irrational hatred beyond my comprehension.
Han-Seol showed me distorted possessiveness beyond the normal level.
Though the types of emotions are different, the common thing is that both of them have an obsession close to madness towards me.
‘Was Han-Seol not the source of the curse, but Han-Seol is also under the curse?’
I couldn’t understand.
‘What the hell is the curse for?
And why does everyone get obsessed with a person called Seo Jin-Wook?
This makes Seo Gyu-Cheol almost certain, too.’
I remembered what happened to the seeds that appeared after killing Park Chang-Hee.
Will the same thing happen if I kill Han-Seol? Will the seed hiding in Han-Seol’s heart appear, and will it try to leech on me instead of the dead host, but it fails to and instead dies to my curse?
I wasn’t sure yet.
Swish!
As I rushed in, I saw Mana patterns flashing all over Han-Seol’s body. The analysis of what equipment she has already that defend against magic and state attacks are clearly visible.
All you need to do with a shield is to break it with a greater force.
I activate a few skills on my body.
[Haste!]
[Physical Strengthening!]
[Body Strengthening!]
[Enhanced Sense of Battle!]
Woooong!
The devil’s sword cried.
The storm of Mana, which rides the sword, burns with purple sword energy.
[Artha’s Sword Dance!]
The movements unfolded, and Han-Seol’s eyes widened.
Spark!
The opponent did not wait as she just looked.
The five-stranded sword energy stretched out from Han-Seol’s sword, tears the fog like lightning.
The flashes that threatened me intertwined and made a whirlwind.
Goooong!
Collision.
The confrontation of power did not last long.
Soon, with a heavy sword noise, a purple storm swept away the sword energy of Han-Seol and then swarmed toward the hidden body behind it.
Han-Seol’s expression was very distorted as if she saw a scene that she couldn’t believe.
“Ugh!”
Han-Seol blocks the purple storm with her sword and barely dodges it.
A purple fang tore the Earth sharply behind her back.
“No way!”
a voice shrieked.
Han Seol’s hand shivered as she bounced off my sword energy. It was the aftershock of overcoming the anti-elastic force.
Three months ago, I was surprised when I first saw the core of Han-Seol. She, who was known as an A-list Hunter in this era, actually had a Mana equivalent to a high-ranking SS Hunter.
But then.
‘You’re not the only one hiding!’
If the sword amplifies my Mana five times, it is like inflating my Mana capacity five times.
Swish!
I threw my body at the speed of light. Following the sword cut horizontally, I drew a half-moon orbit. Han-Seol’s face turned pale after dodging it.
The magic sword, as it sprinkled an arc of light while being swung, it completed a wave of sword energy.
The sword energy left in the air like a remnant should have vanished.
Weing!
But now, along with the place I cut with my sword, the purple lines of arc remained afloat in the air.
The afterimage became real.
“What…. what!”
A wave of sword energy crossed the border between static and dynamic power.
I knew it was a possible attack when one perfectly masters [Artha’s Sword Dance] unfolded in front of Han-Seol’s nose.
‘It’s not the end even if you avoid it.’
Every time our swords struck each other, a storm broke out. The Earth was cut off, and the fog faded for a while. The cold sweat of Han-Seol twinkled in the mist and disappeared. I could see that she couldn’t pull herself together. It’s a situation where even if she concentrates all her senses on finding a chance to attack, and being wary of the sword energy that remained after I swung my sword wasn’t helping her. The number of purple flashes surrounding us increased.
Furthermore, the sword energy did not stay in one place every time. It slipped to an exquisite position to interfere with Han-Seol’s movements while not interrupting my path.
Like setting a trap, I scattered shrapnel of sharp sword energy around me, but I predicted that I could not swing the sword energy for forever.
‘That’s enough!’
I drew in the trajectory of the sword energy that wrapped around me.
Following the suction created with the Mana, a group of purple stars floating in the fog tilted a blunt force in one direction.
[Suction!]
At the same time, a purple rain shower fell. It was rain against the flow of gravity. A fierce sword energy 360 degrees around Han-Seol, pouring towards her body.
At that moment, Mana flashed in Han-Seol’s heart.
Boosh!
Subsequent vibrations shook the spine and the bones.
Boo-boo-boo-boom!
Hundreds of sword energies collided with Han-Seol at the center and sprayed light.
Dust storms caused by shock waves pushed the fog away, after a while, in the place where even the dust was settled.
“Huff…. Huff….!”
Han-Seol was ragged but stood still, hacked by the sword energy.
In front of her were thin curtains of light like the aurora, countlessly overlapped and softly flowing as it made waves.
It was a shield that had stopped the attack just now.
That was also disposable, as was the [Mirage Shield].
‘There’s no next time.’
The attack now was of a destructive force that did not have to be stopped by using that item.
Being in the defensive position, she had no choice but to mobilize it urgently, and I went easy on spending Mana as I knew she would block the attack once anyway.
Poof!
I kicked the ground.
With the shock wave, I rushed to Han-Seol.
When she was dodging and making a distance from me, I sensed something approaching me at an alarming rate.
I was a little slow to notice it because of the fog.
‘Damn it!’
It stopped about 10 meters from us.
Han-Seol has not yet recognized its existence, but my eyes grew more prominent when I saw the thing swaying beyond the fog.
Whooooong!
A red Mana soared up in the fog.
I couldn’t believe my eyes, but it was unfolding in front of me.
I’d seen that skill.
Not in this era, but in my previous life as Choi Seung-Hyun!
‘Is this it? The connection!’
My assumption was wrong.
‘Was the connection was made here?’
Feeling like my heart was about to explode, I changed the sword’s path that I swung as if it were attacking Han-Seol and sent the sword energy into the fog.
The skill that someone beyond the fog was preparing was halted.
Then, through the fog, some cognition permeated my mind.
It was telepathy that anyone within a specific range could hear.
– You’re quick to sense. I thought you wouldn’t be able to see me if I was this far because of the fog.
Han-Seol and I faced each other.
And some being that has sent telepathy to us, away in the fog.
The situation entered an unexpected area.
It was not telepathy that shot an opponent specifically, but a will that was scattered within a certain range like a wave of sound, and the magic sword which listened to it too told me.
‘Uh… huh? Wait a minute…. I’ve heard of this telepathy somewhere, didn’t I?’
The being, hidden in the fog, revealed itself.
Han-Seol looked at her in dismay.
Then, the magic sword suddenly burst out.
‘Oh, I get it! This wave is ··· Immortal! Immortal! Damn it! Damn it! Damn it! Hey, we need to run now. If that uses a skill once, we’ll all end with that. Come on! No, or just ‘accept’ my offer! We’re all going to be finished here!’
Han-Seol’s eyes were fixated on the combat uniform the opponent was wearing. It’s Nicole’s clothes.
On the other hand, my eyes were fixated on her face.
My voice squeezed out through my teeth.
“Angelica!”
*
The sword pecked at me like it was convulsing.
‘Hurry up! You should be glad the monster doesn’t know the language yet, so it uses telepathy; I wouldn’t recognize it if it imitated a human! Run! Run! Am I not telling you to run away? Immortals can manipulate all beings and take out their memories. Are you not hearing me? Whatever happens, don’t give my handle to that monster! No!’
Then, in the fog, Angelica suddenly triggered the skill again. At a much faster pace than before.
The red Mana was woven long and clumped together in the form of hands and arms.
One of the two hands rushed to Han-Seol and the other to me.
Spark!
– Skills [The Successor’s Eyes (Rank: EX)] Resists this skill [Dominating Touch (Rank: SSS, Active)].
The moment the red hand touched my body, the spark popped.
It’s the same as then.
The message continues since I had contacted the skill effect.
[Dominating Touch (Rank: SSS)]
Skill Effect: Able to freely control nearby targets during the time the skill is cast.
Passively, the subject’s memory can be read, and simple memory manipulation and suggestive injection are possible. Manipulated memories or infused hints are maintained even after the skill’s casting time is over.
Restrictions: 1) The number of objects that can be manipulated once activated is limited to four. 2) If the manipulated memory or suggestion is extremely different from the target’s common sense, values, or deeply desired goal, the memory and suggestion will be nullified after the skill ends. However, this penalty does not apply during the casting of the skill.
Han-Seol twisted and turned in great agony.
“Grr….Aghhh!”
– Hmm? Why is it so resistant? ··· Did someone touch it first?
As if it was delightful, it was followed by shady telepathy.
Communication through the medium of consciousness, not sound, took place at the same speed as light.
– Still, it’s only a matter of time. Now, come on. Stop resisting…. and open everything. Tell me everything about you, about your kind, and everything about the world.
Soon, it whispered joyfully.
It seemed to read the memory of Han-Seol.
Oh! Future prophecy? All right. That’s a rare ability. I’ll take you. Taking her?
Hahaha! That’s a catch. Don’t worry; you must have been unable to control it properly even though it was your unique skill. I’ll teach you how. You can put away the unconscious fear that you might lose your mind. My head was spinning. I think at the speed of light as if time had slowed down.
I heard a notification that the boundaries of the third stage of the dungeon had collapsed.
Hunters at different levels or people left on Earth did not hear of it.
And the being that must have come through by going over the stage three boundary
was an opponent in Nicole’s clothes and Angelica’s face.
And it was taking Han-Seol?
‘Now, I get it.’
On what transpired in this era:
The three, who entered the third stage in their previous lives, were the original Seo Jin-Wook, who was considered the greatest geniuses of all time, Nicole with a unique, specialized skill, and Han-Seol, the leader of the expedition.
The stage three portal, which was opened only once then, would have led to the same dungeon as it was now.
In the end, they succeeded in Clear, but none of the three returned to the second stage. In the end, the only thing the latecomers could see was evidence of Clear not far from the portal and the key to the dungeon.
‘People judged those three to be dead.’
Seventeen survivors returned to the first stage with the key, where they were told strange things by the hunters who were waiting there.
The message on the portal showed that there were 18 entrants in the second stage.
But only 17 people were back.
Likewise, there was one more person in what the Earth’s gate indicated.
However, they could not keep the ‘very unstable’ dungeon open because of one unidentified person. Because they only got the key to close the gate and the possibility of the dungeon break has not yet disappeared.
The government had returned all hunters and soon confirmed that the gate entrants changed to zero.
And they shut the gate relentlessly.
A mystery that had never been solved.
Now, the scene in front of me is combined with future historical records to create a story.
‘The number of entrants in the system message doesn’t count to the number of people who didn’t enter through the portal.’
In other words, the message does not count alien races that cross the border.
The gap between 18 and 17 people meant that the one unidentified being was a human Hunter.
What if one of them came back with another survivor?
Stage 3 to stage 2, then to stage 1 ··· and finally to Earth.
Probably in a state similar to Stealth, being suppressed by someone else.
Hmm? And, only then was Angelica interested in me.
What are you? This isn’t resistance. What is this reaction? I could see what would happen if it stayed like this.
Han-Seol is gradually collapsing.
Angelica concentrates on her skill from afar but no longer approaches.
Can’t she move during a skill activation?
There was definitely a penalty that does not entirely reveal in the system messages.
Then, at this window!
“G….rr!”
She was struggling as if in great pain, but Han-Seol did not take her gaze off me even in the midst of pain.
It was great resistance, unlike how even my former colleagues were manipulated at once.
However, it only took time, but the red Mana was slowly dyeing the brain of Han-Seol.
I could see that she wasn’t far. In the end, Han-Seol will kneel.
“Jin… Wook! If I can’t have you, I’d rather… with my own hands!”
It took only a few seconds for all of this to be recognized and determined.
If Han-Seol could be brainwashed.
Before the enemy, who had already tried to kill me, attacks me under its domination.
I aimed first for the incapacitated enemy who was closer to me.
I started with a definite reduction in the number of enemies.
Crush!
As I focused my attention, [The Successor’s Eyes] crushed the red hand on my head.
– What?!
At that moment, I threw my body. The other red hand was still connected to Han-Seol.
The skill was active, and Angelica was still standing there.
As I ran away from the grip of the hand’s domination, the magic sword then murmured as if it had realized it.
‘Perfect, mental type immunity?’
But before Angelica could respond from afar, I, much closer to Han-Seol, concentrated Mana on my hand and thrust her into her heart!
Crush!
“Keugh!”
Like Park Chang-Hee, Han-Seol was alive for a while even though her heart was penetrated.
‘I’m not handing over Han-Seol to Angelica!’
I activated the skill in that manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 53
chapters.content:
Siheung 8 Dungeon (6)
Han-Seol’s body lost its strength and fell.
The light of the Mana core disappeared from the torn heart.
It was ironic that the end of the person who wanted to own me all to herself faced death in the form of absorption.
Thud!
The corpse rolled on the floor. Her eyes were staring at me even after she died.
‘As expected, there it is! It was a curse.’
I could see it clearly.
The threadlike energy left the empty heart where the Mana disappeared.
Like the last time with Park Chang-Hee, I quickly leaped away from the corpse before the curse that lost its host goes ballistic.
What…?!! As soon as she died, the red hand connected to Han-Seol’s head disappeared.
Angelica, I mean, the alien being, which had not yet decided on a name to disguise itself as a human being, seemed baffled. The telepathy carried its emotion.
No way! It’s a race without a defense against this! What kind of powerful brainwashing agents is there that’s left to interfere···?! In that short time, it seems to have acquired knowledge of humanity from the memory of Han-Seol.
Boosh!
The alien being did not give up and activated its skill once again. I then saw a much bigger hand that was stronger than the two red hands. It came to my head and opened its palm to grab my entire head. This time, it gave its best.
But then.
‘That is a critical mistake.’
If it doesn’t work once, one should give up immediately and try to bring out another method.
However, the mediocre knowledge gained through Han-Seol seems to have instilled false confidence.
It was a good thing for me.
The sword spoke in a soft voice while the red hand was fiercely hovering around my head.
It certainly seemed to know something about that alien race.
“An immortal? Does immortality mean a limitless life span? Or some kind of resurrection that brings it back to life? Which one is it?”
It didn’t answer immediately, unlike before.
It thought it was shocking that I have perfect immunity to mental type skills.
A strategy for a person like me was to keep trying the [Whisper of the Sword] for years, which was an attack to the mind, to induce action and to let me consent to the proposal, aiming for a weakened state in mind or when I’m careless.
It found out that the strategy would never work for me.
“Shutting your mouth? At this moment… of all the times?”
This kind of shitty tactic wouldn’t work for me.
I vaguely knew why the devil’s sword is so afraid of people with brainwashing skills.
“Are you going to let me die here and let it hold this handle? Are you okay with that?”
Although there was a physical thing called the sword, the demon sword is more like a cognitive being that cannot control its own will.
The possibility that someone else could take over the will, which was the only factor that proves its existence as a cognitive being, was equivalent to its presence being erased, so it must have felt fear towards death.
The answer came right back.
‘The immortals are parasites.’
The current host is Nicole.
“When the host dies, it moves to another entity or changes its species to continue its life. No one knows how old it is. The secret of immortality is the ability as a creature to change the body and the unique skill of manipulating the target and being able to read memories. There is no better defense than being read and manipulated.’
What, then, “It means I can kill it.”
If the brainwash doesn’t work, and, “If I don’t give it a chance to move on to another object.”
On the other hand, this thought came to mind as I listened.
Parasitism and brainwashing.
It was too similar to the skill effect of [Mercadius’ Seed].
What’s the connection?
‘The only way and purpose of its life is to reign over all beings of the species and to make fun of them by manipulating its fate from the shadows. Depending on the tutorial’s progress, if it is believed that the life span of the species and society has expired, it discards them and transfers to another dimension. If the race has the means to fight against a mental attack, it runs away. If it thinks that civilization’s level is too low to be interesting, it also throws it away. It’s rare to find a species that fits all of these conditions and that is also in the early stages of the tutorial and are connected to the dungeon.’
I remembered what Angelica said in my previous life.
‘I told you. A year ago, too many died than I expected. That’s all.’
Did it lose interest in Earth, which was so crumbled that it could not sustain civilization, even though the tutorials had started?
It said this,
‘I’m not going to break the egg. When the egg hatches, the gate and the dungeon do not disappear even after the tutorial ends. Rather, it will link this place to more dimensions. With more choices!’
If we had broken the Dimensional Bird’s Egg, all dungeons would have been closed, and Angelica would have been trapped on Earth.
So the reason for it to climb the Tower of Choice to the 100th floor, instead of running away to another dimension through the dungeon, was so it could connect to more worlds?
To increase its chances of finding the right species?
‘Angelica indeed predicted in my previous life that the Tower would rise, but the system explained the meaning of the Tower anyway.’
Humanity would have somehow climbed the Tower in that situation. Even without Angelica’s prophecy.
Is that why she climbed together with us and intervened?
I grimaced.
An uncontrollable rage rose within me.
In the end, it pretended to save humanity, but when it lost interest and did not need it, it simply threw them away.
Spark!
Angelica gave up and retracted her skill.
This skill, which continues to consume Mana while it is activated, has already consumed a considerable amount.
The Devil sword asks, ‘Are you really going to fight? No one has ever beaten that monster!’.
There was something that the devil’s sword can’t see right now.
Nicole’s body, which was probably thanks to Han-Seol, did not have a single defensive artifact. It did not have a battle backpack or items such as a Mana potion.
In other words, it was impossible to recover the consumed Mana.
Without the Rune Stone, magic became less efficient.
‘The odds are good enough.’
I rushed right into it.
Swish!
Boo-boom!
The purple sword energy rips the Earth.
It used its skill right away.
It avoided the attack and hid as if it was melting into the air.
‘It would need this type of skill to escape the Hunters’ eyes and return to Earth with Han-Seol.’
[Stealth] of SS-Rank.
However, stealth skills must also use Mana, and the Mana that spouts from the heart and fills the body does not disappear just because it becomes concealed.
I stiffened and waited breathlessly as if I had missed it in sight. I looked around intentionally and watched out.
Once separated from me, the alien kept its Stealth and approached me again quietly.
The highest level of skill, having completely eliminated sound and presence.
It created a blade by restructuring its hand.
It must have believed that I wouldn’t be able to respond to it, as it approached quietly to my side without a clue.
I stuck my knife in it without turning my head!
Pshk!
K-aaargh! Terrible telepathy reaches my mind—a manifestation of terrible pain.
It managed to appear when [Stealth] was broken. I aimed for the heart but pierced its shoulder as it must have twisted its body at the last second.
H-How! How! Now that it knew that [Stealth] doesn’t work, it won’t approach him like this.
It was the first and last chance.
I didn’t mean to drag this to a long war.
I needed to end this before it learns more about my abilities.
Thuff!
A storm-like shock wave blew up inside Angelica’s body using the devil’s sword as a medium.
As it lost its right arm, it made distance while having lost its balance.
But still, its heart was fine. The Mana core remains in shape.
And.
Blgh blgh!
The severed arm sprang up in an instant to form a sword again.
It freely manipulated its flesh.
I caught up and attacked.
A heated battle came and went. Angelica poured all her skills on me and attacked me by concentrating her arm with Mana, which she shaped like a sword. Every time the two of us clashed, the atmosphere shook. In a single moment, 3333 pieces of light needles poured from the surrounding area.
– Tsk!
It must have been hard to withstand the power amplified by the sword. It ran away quickly, making distance. I intercepted before there was more space.
[Lightning Buster!]
The Lightning type rune stone sparkled, and a whirlpool that housed lightning poured out from my hand. Heavy current, pouring like a waterfall, hits the opponent.
Paht!
The immortal clustered the Mana together to defend itself. I kicked the ground and followed.
I continuously activated several skills while I was in motion.
Even if it was impossible to cast several simultaneously as Hibiki, I could cast them continuously.
[Overture for the resentment]
[Gravity Compression]
[Magma Field]
Dozens of opaque hands appeared in the air, wrapping the immortal’s body, and the rapidly strengthened gravity in a certain area weighed it down. Then the land in the direction of its escape suddenly melts into magma, boiling and blocking its retreat.
– This…!
He used a counterspell without a rune stone to get rid of the hand that held him. Risking her bones being crushed, it turned direction in the compressional force and leaped to a high altitude in a place where there is lava. No, to be exact, it flew by using magic to the middle of the fog.
‘Levitation without a rune stone! The Mana consumption will be enormous.’
The sight of its back as it flew in the air as if it was going to get away…
It’s too slow to miss.
Immediately, I spread the [Stardust Wing] and flew to catch up.
Whip!
This would not have been expected.
The distance that she ran away with all her might returned to zero in an instant.
I see Angelica’s face distorted by embarrassment in front of me.
What… Is this! I didn’t miss the flow.
I kept swinging the sword without giving it the leeway to run further away.
I then guided it in the direction so that it could not go down to the ground. To let it consume Mana without being able to stop.
Also, it needed several times more Mana than I had used to prevent my amplified attack through the devil’s sword.
Every time the sword cuts through the air, the purple sword energy pushes out space, creating a shock wave, and blares out the air with heat. I shuffled a series of attacks. Every time I sliced the air, some of the arcs of light left behind following the trajectory stayed still, while others fiercely attacked Angelica with varying speed. Others were shot forward like a remote-controlled missile.
– What the hell!
It is gradually being pushed back as if it was unbelievable.
I blocked its path when it tried to get down to the ground.
‘It’s the heart.’
I was looking at the embedded core in its heart, what was once Nicole’s, waving in a strange form.
A sight not seen in Angelica in my previous life. Has it not been fully established because of the short time it was used as a host?
At first glance, it is no different from the normal human core, but whenever a shock was applied, it scattered like light smoke and gathered again.
‘It was said that it was a parasite.’
I presumed that’s the real source.
Poof!
A storm created by several layers of sword strikes intertwined with each other and cornered Angelica.
Magic followed.
[Titanium imprisonment!]
Dozens of titanium metal bars intersect in the air, horizontally and vertically, covering the immortal.
Then they tightened towards Angelica, who was located in the center.
Paht!
And another counterspell.
In an instant, the prison of metal rods disappeared.
Angelica’s Mana disappears in chunks.
Stumble!
It began to affect Levitation.
‘Now, it’s enough!’
It was enough to de-energize the prey.
Now it was time to pierce the neck.
Wooong!
On the blade of the devil’s sword, a mountain of sword energy was clustered together.
High-density energy is drawn to the limit and concentrated at a point. Along with the sword, the light and atmosphere are distorted and effervesce. The hands holding the hilt felt numb.
Angelica’s face is ruined as it directly faces it.
This was the critical shot.
The opponent no longer has the power to escape.
I struck it without hesitation!
Goooong!
The shockwave spread in all directions.
Angelica, who barely managed to block it with her hand, was thrown away without withstanding the force’s weight and shock waves on the sword.
-Aghhh!
This time, as I intended, to the ground!
Bang!
Angelica fell to the ground at a dreadful speed.
The crash site created a crater of enormous size.
Between the clouds of dust, there was a shadow wriggling in the cracks of the Earth.
‘It’s over.’
Quietly, I got off next to it.
It was pathetic to see how a being, which had been avoiding all risks by relying on its skill of mental control, was responding when it met an enemy that was immune to it.
The secret of living long enough to be named immortal was not because it was strong, but because it was only against enemies whose minds could be controlled, and when it was impossible, it was evident that it ran away and saved itself.
Angelica’s body, which is stuck on the ground in a bizarre form, as if all the bones in her body had shattered.
‘Its regeneration is slower than before.’
It moves slowly as if it fitted a broken bone.
Mana was also needed for physical manipulation.
W-wait! Just before saving the Earth, the faces of my colleagues, who had died because of Angelica’s betrayal, flashed in front of my eyes.
‘The bad luck of my past life ···.’
I took a step closer.
‘Sees its end, here.’
Wait, wait! Don’t kill me! I’ve lived a long time that you can’t even imagine! Knowledge and secrets such as treasure acquired throughout many dimensions must be useful to you, too! I swear my loyalty, please! If you’re with me, you can read the memories of all the humans in your world and control them as you please! It was the last struggle for its life.
– I can’t die like this. To think of how long. How long I have ········!
It was a physical injury to the level that even if one’s a Hunter, it is natural that one must die, but Angelica is still alive.
Still, whether the ragged state affected it, the core is the heart was not maintaining its shape and was shaking as if it was about to collapse.
Instead of human cores that look like crystals, it tries to change into smoke-like forms.
‘In the words of the devil’s sword, immortals are beings that are at the border between matter and non-materials.’
The human-like species held Mana cores in the heart, but the body of the immortal that I see now is almost integrated with the Mana core.
The Mana core itself is part of the body, not the Mana core inside the body.
“If I leave it like this, it may find another body and move on.’
A way to completely extinguish this body that is neither material nor nonmaterial.
There was a much simpler way.
‘Mana Drain.’
Crush!
My hand that broke the rib stopped right in front of Angelica’s heart.
In that state, I didn’t use my skills just yet.
There was one question that was not answered yet. From a being called immortal, I found something too exquisite in common to be a coincidence between ‘brainwashing’ and ‘parasitism.’
“I don’t want to let this kind of alien roam around Earth anyway.’
Every man, every hunter, was like a weapon in the hands of the immortal. It was impossible to neglect such a monster and let it free in the human world.
Such an ulterior motive is kept only in the heart.
As I felt my finger touching the heart wall, I asked it.

chapters.title: Chapter 54
chapters.content:
Mercadius’ Seeds
I had not yet guaranteed that the immortal possessed knowledge about this skill. However, I knew I couldn’t kill it right away without even attempting to ask. After all, the similarity between the immortal and [Mercardius’ Seeds] seemed more than just a coincidence.
And so, as I prepared to absorb it with [Mana Drain], I asked it straightforwardly.
But then, the answer I got in return was…
-Merca… What?
My attempt proved to be fruitless.
Either it really didn’t know what it was, or it was busy coming up with an underhanded scheme. I didn’t mean to go easy on it, so I added some more force on my finger.
At this, the thing hurriedly spoke once more.
-Wait, wait! Wait! Do you know how many skills there are in the world? Including unique skills, it’s impossible for one to know everything! However, there is always a pattern evident among them. Explain it in more detail!
I contemplated for a moment. Upon sensing my hesitation, it continued.
-Let me start with something I can infer right now! Since there is a proper noun in the skill, it is currently someone’s unique skill, or even if it weren’t, it originated from a unique skill. And it could mean that an Awakened has made a deal with the system to modify or change it!
Wait, what did that mean?
“Modifying the unique skills? Change it?”
As I showed interested in this information, it quickly began to pour more details into my mind.
– This option could only be revealed when the being meets the special condition in the dimension where the tutorial has finished! The transaction condition is that the system retrieves the unique skill acquired at the moment of Awakening. The Awakened one has nothing to lose. Instead of the unique skill being retrieved, the system opens the path for the Awakened to obtain an enhanced and modified version, or change it to a completely different kind of unique skill.
– Unique skills retrieved by the system will be set up to reduce performance and be converted to a normal skill card, so that other Awakened people can learn. Only the system knows how many dimensions it will distribute the skill cards to and how many it can duplicate.
It was information that could not be known in the past, seeing as we had not finished the tutorial.
Two more facts could be inferred from the words of the immortal.
– A unique skill is something that the system can’t create by itself. If it could, there would be no need to trade one with an Awakened to retrieve it. If it was possible, it could just make such a skill by itself.
Aside from that, it was apparently also possible that the very generic skills that Hunters learned through cards may actually be unique skills of Awakens that existed in other dimensions long ago.
“Are you saying that we can trade in skills with proper nouns by modifying or replacing them again?”
– It is possible! That’s how all of the normal skills with proper nouns are made.
If so, then that should be the case with [Artha’s Sword Dance].
I remembered when the devil’s sword witnessed my sword movement. It immediately recited the name of ‘King Artha.’
“Is the proper noun in the skill’s name of the Awakened person who modified or changed the skill?”
Was the name of the man who planted this curse in me ‘Mercadius’?
– Not necessarily. Depending on the Awakened’s intentions, it may be named after a mythical and legendary being that are passed down to the society instead of their own names, or the name of the region, country, or any unique concept.
I found it all ambiguous.
However, the more I thought about it, the more it hurt my head. Modification of unique skills was an option only available in a world where tutorials had been completed?
Based on the Mana color, my body’s curse was indeed a unique skill that the creator had unfolded by himself, not a normalized skill.
Then that meant that the being which had cast this curse upon me was not human.
‘This is too much. I would be prepared if I could at least know their race.’
With this, I asked, “Have you ever heard of Mercadius?”
– I haven’t.
I threw some keywords to the immortal that would specify the skill [Mercardius’ Seeds].
“Have you ever seen this kind of unique skill? Or something similar to it?”
Then, as if it found it surprising, it replied with agitated telepathy after a brief silence had occurred.
···What… is this? It was too similar to its being.
– I don’t know who the caster is, but it has reached a tremendous level. The unique skill may not have been modified only one or two times. You judge this skill as of two functions: ‘brainwashing’ and ‘parasitism,’ but what’s more important to note is that it is linked to a parasitic creature on the host.
These were red tentacle-like creatures that made a cry like an animal’s whenever they were overpowered by [The Successor’s Eyes]. They then implanted a seed that would be hidden in the heart of the host via a yarn.
– There is no life-creating skill, but it is possible to modify something that already exists. This is a skill that is very rare and can only be accomplished by consuming a huge amount of Mana.
Who the hell was I up against?
“How do I track down the caster of the skill?”
– A permanently invoked curse cannot be quickly scattered.
[Dominating Touch] alone was subject to limitations, and the Mana was consumed throughout the duration. However, this skill had already been maintained for ten years.
– Special conditions must have been met to plant the curse. Therefore···
At this point, the immortal looked hopeful.
– To find the criminal, you must keep me alive!
What the hell was it saying now?
– Allow me to stay in this host or, if not, prepare a body of another Awakened to become my host. Not the woman whose heart is torn. Restoration of the host’s body is possible once I have settled in the heart.
I wasn’t even thinking about it, and it still had lots of requirements for the creature in danger.
– Listen. I can search through the memory of living things without missing out on anything to determine what happened throughout their lives. There must be a special occasion where curses were invoked even if you don’t realize it yourself! I can search the memory of the cursed hosts, and you can find out what they have in common! If you follow that link, you’ll find out who the caster of the skill is!
I could see what it meant by its words. With this skill, I could look through the minds of Han-seol, Park Chang-Hee, and the original Seo Jin-Wook. Seo Gyu-Cheol was also a possible target.
In other words, if this being could look through the memory of all of them, I could gather valuable information.
– I can bring up memories that you yourself have forgotten for a long time. Therefore, you must save me!
The immortal had obviously guessed why I had asked it this.
No, it decided in the first place that the reason why I didn’t get affected by its [Dominating Touch] was that I had other kinds of brainwashing.
This was the reason behind its confidence. However…
‘Am I crazy? To let you go to Earth?’
I asked as I let it flow with the other ear.
“Can you read the memory of the dead?”
-····It’s impossible. But you can still bring all the suspicious ones among those still living in front of me!
I found that part meaningless.
I asked a few more questions, but almost all of the answers it gave me were speculative ones. Instead of things about [Mercardius’ Seed], it gave out general concepts about those similar kinds of curses. Knowledge that was unknown to the Earth in my previous life was quite helpful.
By this time, I was certain that I had almost all the information I needed. An idea suddenly popped into my head.
“One more thing.”
I was hoping that this might be the last.
“Your race, what’s the population? How many more are there besides you?”
There was something that I couldn’t understand when I heard the explanation from the devil’s sword. This was because this being that was called an immortal seemed to be the only one existing in the entirety of the dimensions.
The alien answered with a short silence.
– I existed alone from the moment I gained my will. Of course, I don’t have any memory of before I existed. Other beings of the same race have never been seen even after traveling through so many worlds.
In short, this was a species with only one individual from beginning to end.
Of course, this was not normal. There was only one reason as to why such abnormal races exist, from my point of view.
“Someone touched it.”
– What?
There was a concept that had always remained in the explanation of the immortal. There was a kind that could modify a life form among the unique skills.
A parasite was linked to the [Mercardius’ Seed]. Therefore, the seed may be such a modified entity.
If so···
I called it with a name that I thought fitting rather than calling it an immortal.
“Parasite, you could also be someone’s skill-modulated existence. Your existence itself could be a by-product of some other skill.”
As soon as I said this, I could feel the creature’s utter disgust.
Undecoded telepathy had started pouring into my mind. The raging anger swirled and poked my mind like a thorn. However, it still couldn’t do me any harm because of [The Successor’s Eyes].
The parasite itself couldn’t have not thought of what I had inferred.
After a long period of self-examination, it must have come up with this possibility; the idea that itself could be a component or by-product of a skill.
The only difference between it and the seed was the intelligence and presence of Mana core.
‘Must it be the same being that made the curse on me? The idea itself is very similar. I can’t tell at this stage.’
Furthermore, the interrogation could no longer continue. I had already noticed the raging parasite sneaking its smoke of Mana out of the heart.
‘Let’s get this over with.’
It didn’t even know that I could see Mana.
It must have thought that my [Stealth] was unusable due to some kind of detection type skills. Because of the missing link in its information, the immortal was now making vain attempts.
Pshk!
I thrust my finger into its heart.
-Damn it!
When it was clear that it would lose its host, it escaped as fast as it could.
-Even if you can do such a thing to the host, you can’t easily destroy my….!
I didn’t even give it a chance to finish; I activated my skill.
[Mana Drain!]
At that moment…
Aghhh! A shriek of the mind that sounded like its living soul was being ripped away echoed in my head.
W- What is this?! No! No! The swirl of suction at the tip of my finger began to absorb the Mana core, much like a wispy cloud of smoke that integrated the parasite’s body along with it.
-No, my being… My existenceee!
If I had to liken it to a creature with a body, would it be like being eaten by a carnivore whilst maintaining its consciousness?
The speed of Mana core absorption was different from the usual.
Perhaps because of the peculiarity of existence, the Mana core, which had mixed in with the parasite, slowly absorbed into my fingertips.
As the absorption progressed, the telepathy it once screamed now became dull and faint.
– No. I’m being consumed. I’m ·······
The wall between emotions, thoughts, memories, and cognition collapsed. It both mixed and shattered.
– I am ··· I am ···
It was never a pleasant experience to witness the collapse of a being’s spirit.
Everything that had made up its world melted and shattered, and eventually left a very thin, shallow mass.
-·······I am.
Once it had been fully absorbed into my finger, an unbelievable silence enveloped me.
I said aloud, “It’s over.”
With this, I put an end to the bad blood of my past life here.
*
After completely finishing Angelica, I approached Han-Seol’s corpse.
‘The common denominator of the surely cursed three. It meant that I had to find it in my memory, right?’
Even if one didn’t realize it for himself or herself, I recalled the end of Park Chang-Hee.
‘If a situation similar to that happens.’
When I pierced through the heart of Han-Seol, I only confirmed the existence of a curse and immediately distanced myself from the body.
I didn’t want to create a situation where the seeds would fight each other in a setting where I also had to fight off the aliens in the vicinity.
‘Is it already gone?’
I looked down at Han-Seol’s body, and my worries proved to be unneeded.
‘It’s livid.’
I could hear it, even from here.
‘Geeeek!’
Red energy was rumbling in the fragments of the already torn heart. I observed its size.
‘It’s almost like the one that Park Chang-Hee had.’
Even when I looked at the one inside my heart or now, it was exactly double the size of that thing right now.
This meant that the size wasn’t different from the host’s potential Mana, or its progress on brainwashing the host.
‘Geeeeek!’
From the seed that had lost its host, a cry similar to that of a small beast came out. It sounded like it was throwing a fit.
‘Is that going to rush at me too?’
However, things were different this time around.
Swoosh!
Like a predator in front of its prey, the curse hidden in my heart produced a red tentacle out of my body.
I knew a similar thing would happen now.
‘Destroy that seed as it was then.’
When Park Chang-Hee’s seed was dying, the memory of Park Chang-Hee was reflected in my mind. His whole life flashed before me.
It was all vast information that one couldn’t remember all just by looking at it once, but···
‘I’m different.’
Once I saw it, I could always remember it, no matter how vast the content was.
‘Memories of original Seo Jin-Wook that are slowly being pieced together, and the memory of Park Chang-Hee. And the memory of Han-Seol.‘
If I compared all these memories, I would eventually find common ground.
‘On who placed this curse on me!’

chapters.title: Chapter 55
chapters.content:
Seo Jin-Wook
‘Geek… Geeek!’
Unlike that of Park Chang-Hee, the curse of Han-Seol did not even get a chance to try and infiltrate my body.
The seed implanted in my heart had evidently first attacked and penetrated with its tentacles. With this, the seed of Han-Seol struggled, spreading something like a red tentacle around it.
‘It’s perishing.’
Witnessing this scene made me wonder about the curse’s mechanism that the system message did not fully expound on.
Why did it want to attack and destroy a seed that had already lost its host?
‘Geeeek!’
The seed of Han-Seol had now clearly reduced its size. A similar phenomenon occurred once more.
A psychological wave had begun to seep from it, connected by the tentacles of my seed. I could now hear a voice.
‘He’s going to be the greatest hunter on Earth. Even if I survive the collapse of Siheung Dungeon, I can’t be as strong as him.’
Voices gradually overlapped, echoed, and changed into different senses.
The life of Han-Seol unfolded before my eyes like a vision.
*
The introduction had begun with a hunter’s desire for heroism.
‘Oh, I have Prophecy! I’m special. I was chosen!’
It was both self-delusion and hypocrisy to say that she didn’t need other people’s recognition and was only doing her duty. Han-Seol wanted to stand out. She wanted to be recognized by people all over the world. However, she found out that she couldn’t rise to be the best, even if she continued to live away from her scheduled death.
‘I can go up to the SS-Rank with this potential Mana. But that’s it.’
The Hunters she had seen in the future had the ability and strength that was the equivalent of a God-like state in her standards, which they had long transcended beyond the boundary of SS-Ranks.
‘If I stay like this, I’ll only be a prophet.’
Jealousy bloomed in her mind. Even though [Prophecy] was her unique skill, she couldn’t perfectly control it. Prophecies always came to her out of the blue, delivering incomplete scenes and information about the future, and then disappeared.
With this in mind, she changed her direction.
‘The kid that will become the most powerful hunter in all of humanity.’
The overwhelmingly strong one, as she had seen him in the future.
However, he was close to a tyrant who committed soaked in madness, beyond the boundaries of law and morality. The state couldn’t act against that one hunter. Even with their all-out efforts, they could not contain him. Han-Seol saw him fight in a scene her Prophecy emitted. She trembled.
‘What if I could own that kid?’
His only weakness was his anxious mind.
‘By being with him from a very young age, to make him only listen to me.’
She had to become the only light that he never had in his childhood.
The plan seemed to be going well for a long time.
Even in the process of his madness worsening, Seo Jin-Wook trusted only one person in the world and followed Han-Seol sincerely.
However, recently, everything had gone wrong.
‘The future has changed.’
After Park Chang-Hee died, Seo Jin-Wook suddenly began to get out of her control.
‘Moreover, he’s gotten stronger at a much faster rate than I had seen in the prediction!’
Seo Jin-Wook’s performance under the guise of Bill Russel was indeed frightening. This was the power of a hunter that only Awakened three months ago. At this rate, he could become much more powerful than she had predicted in decades. First of all, she couldn’t find the same madness in him as before, and she couldn’t control him as she once did.
‘If I can’t have him···’
Han-Seol had not realized that a shady madness had now mixed into her desire.
‘If I can’t have him….I’d rather…!’
*
I frowned at Han-Seol’s life as it flashed in front of my eyes. The curse’s effect that controlled her was the same as Park Chang-Hee’s. Its goal was to amplify a person’s desire, the most vivid feelings, and to flood it with madness.
‘All the nonsense she said in front of me was true. She was just trying to kill me because she didn’t think making me her puppet would work anymore. She wanted to kill me before I could grow even more.’
The moment she had decided to kill me, she had been completely devoured by madness. How could one understand a crazy person? I shook my head.
‘Like Park Chang-Hee, there is no specific memory of someone planting a curse.’
Han-Seol’s memories had rushed through me in an instant, but it was quite time-consuming to compare them and analyze them one by one in order to find suspicious commonalities.
‘Nothing to see after the madness has completely taken over. I’ll have to look at her process of reaching that point.’
I needed to find clues hidden within her memory. It wouldn’t happen in a day or two.
‘First of all, I should return.’
I completely erased the traces of Han-Seol and began to move with Nicole’s body, which had been mutated by the immortal. As I approached the portal that led to the second stage, I saw two lost expedition members that were unable to move due to the thick fog. One of them pointed their finger at me.
“Oh, look over there! It’s Bill Russell!”
It was now time to go back to Earth.
*
I knew it was necessary to mix truth and lie in moderation. This was in order to explain why two Hunters had suddenly died when the dungeon attack had already been completed. I revealed that an alien race from a different dimension had decided to invade as soon as it was cleared. The proof of my argument lay in Nicole’s body, which had been mutated by the parasite. The existence of an alien race with unexpected abilities now shocked the world.
“It parasites in the human body and changes the flesh? And then it pretends to be human, and even manipulates it?”
“How many of them are there? What’s the number of species?”
“If many of them were to infiltrate the Earth, wouldn’t humans be completely devoured?”
So far, the alien race that we had encountered in the dungeon had already existed within some predictable category, whether it was friendly or hostile.
However, the new species had completely changed the concept of potential enemy classification.
Each government now struggled to come up with a manual on how to respond if they were to reencounter such creatures.
‘Well, it would be hard to come up with a reasonable plan right now.’
I was rewarded as Bill Russell upon successfully playing my part, and I returned to the United States after rejecting all the fuss about being rewarded by order of the Nation.
It was now the time to shift my place with the real Bill Russell.
As the hero who played the most important role in stopping the S-Class dungeon collapse, he had come to the media’s attention around the world and expressed disapproval, saying that it became a bigger fuss than he thought it would be.
In a few days, Bill Russell would flip the media again.
He would be announcing his retirement.
‘We’ll need to be on the same page, so I should inform him.’
Bill Russell had to know what had happened in the dungeon in preparation for further interviews, so information on that part was completely conveyed. In the meantime, there was news as big as Bill Russell in Korea. It was about the Celestial Dragon Guild.
“I heard that Han-Seol, the Assistant Guild Master, is dead, too? After Park Chang-Hee Hunter, the bad news only continues.”
“But this time, things have been a little weird. Many of the top-notch hunters are showing signs of leaving the Celestial Dragons.”
“They believe in Han-Seol and follow her, so does that mean they don’t want to continue working under Seo Gyu-Cheol?”
“There was a rumor going around among the hunters about the internal situation. Guild Master Seo Gyu-Cheol has long lost his internal support. They said his guild operational capability is actually worse than that of Han-Seol’s.”
“The saying that it is the best guild in Korea should soon become history.”
Just as she completely captured the heart of the original Seo Jin-Wook, Han-Seol was considered a true leader who could be trusted and was followed by other guild members. I clicked my tongue at the news brought about by her death.
‘It’s a talent to hold the people’s hearts this far without brainwashing skills.’
Internally, Han-Seol’s status was strong and mighty. However, it had been enough to push Seo Gyu-Cheol behind.
“In the meantime, there are rumors that his son, who Seo Gyu-Cheol was pushing him to be his successor, is also missing.”
He desperately wanted to hide an internal situation, but words seemed to leak out as the guild had been shaken to its core. The media’s reaction was divided. While praising Celestial Dragon Guild as they contributed greatly to the attack, others presented a dark analysis of the future prospects in a subtle tone. And, as it began to show that the hunters were actually leaving the guild, Senators called for me. It had been a long time since I saw him face to face.
*
“They were parasitic alien kinds? I’d like to hear more details.”
With a much darker expression than I had ever seen before, I delivered everything I could say in front of him. Some of them were more detailed than what I had reported to the government. It was unlikely that another immortal being would appear in terms of circumstances, but it would be helpful enough to broaden the scope of information about alien races.
When the talk was over, Senators remained silent for a while. Then, he breathed in deeply as he lit his cigar. I watched the smoke spread through the room, and he spoke with a lot of sorrow infused in his tone.
“Losing Nicole hurts my bones.”
I nodded. Nicole also seemed to be a person worthy of Senator’s attention. She could have been dispatched to Korea even though she was only an SS-class hunter because of his help. The U.S. government may not have wanted it.
“We were able to successfully clear by your help of sending her with us.”
I had to admit this fact, since I didn’t have any skills to replace that unique skill.
“In case a dungeon collapses, the judgment that it doesn’t matter since it doesn’t direct one only shows that he only knows one but not the other. We have yet to experience a collapse of the S-Class dungeon. No one can guarantee how fast the fire will spread.”
That was the Senator’s belief. Human beings should make all-out efforts to prevent disasters beyond the borders.
‘He tends to measure risk as conservative as possible. His direction of lobbying people in Washington is also focused on deregulating Hunter and Dungeon items because he believes that humanity’s preparation for unknown threats is still absurd.’
Considering what would happen in the future, the Senator’s judgment was right.
‘Making a black market so that if anyone needs to, they could circulate items outside the boundaries of the law, was of the same intention. Our thoughts coincide in this aspect. As expected, it was good to make ties with him as soon as possible.’
This was to not underestimate future risks. It was a mindset that proved to be the most necessary for humanity now.
“But then…”
He glanced at me.
“Are you going to continue your major career in the U.S.? I’d like to recommend you to do so, too.”
He may not have been saying this out of patriotism when he had just expressed the need to go beyond selfishness among nations.
The following words were just what I had expected.
“The U.S. is one of the countries that gates are mostly discovered in the world. No matter how much power we have, we still don’t have enough.”
He was recommending, for realistic reasons, that the U.S. needed a lot of hunters.
“What do you think about maintaining a state of a freelancer like now, but signing a loose contract with my agency? I don’t want to tie a leash on you, so you don’t have to worry.”
“You’re asking me when you know I’m going to reject it, right?”
Tsk, he clicked his tongue. He spoke once more in a disappointed tone.
“Tell me whenever you change your mind. I’ll take care of you a lot more than one would take care of a freelancer.”
No matter how loose the leash may be, the leash was still a leash. Considering what would happen in the upcoming days, it was only natural for me to choose to belong to the group that would move according to my own will.
And I had already decided where the group would be.
“By the way, I’m not a freelancer.”
The Senator’s eyebrows wiggled.
“I thought I understood that the relationship between the father and the son was dreadful? That the family situation is a mess, too.”
I was sure he already got the details of the Celestial Dragon Guild.
The Senator spoke once more. “Are you going to keep the enemy around as you live as a runaway child?”
I smiled lightly.
“It’s about time that runaway kid returned.”
The Siheung 8 dungeon entered a precarious status much faster in this life than in the future.
Was it a butterfly effect that I had made? Questions still lingered over this assumption.
To make a wild guess, did I influence the Siheung dungeon, simply because I cleared the dungeon that was supposed to be removed later in my previous life?
‘There may be some system behavior that I don’t know, so it’s too early to say …’
Anyway, if one event was advanced, the others could be, too.
One couldn’t just wait to see disasters, such as the collapse of the SSS-class dungeon, to occur simultaneously as in the past.
‘From now on, I can’t do it alone.’
Because of this, I was thinking of using the Celestial Dragon Guild as my stepping stone.
The person who planted the curse could not be identified, but I couldn’t always live while keeping my head down.
‘I will rebuild the Celestial Dragon with my own hands.’
It would be a waste to start at the bottom to prepare for the future. There was no need to give up the items, capital, and reputation that Celestial Dragon had already accumulated. As a first step toward the acquisition, I was going to make Seo Gyu-Cheol come down from his spot soon.
‘Of course, I have to show them that I deserve it.‘
I was going to put an end to moving around with another identity. From now on, I would prove my worth as Seo Jin-Wook.

chapters.title: Chapter 56
chapters.content:
Team Building (1)
After finishing up my transition with the original Bill Rusell and having watched his retirement declaration flip the entire world, I quietly returned to Korea. The first place I decided to head to was a private luxury villa in Hannam-dong, which had been rented under the company’s name.
‘Has it been a month now?’
Nate and Hibiki… It had been that long since I last saw them. It was because it took quite a while to Clear Sihueng 8 Dungeon, and I ended up staying in the U.S. way longer than I planned to.
“Hey, it’s Jin-Wook!”
They must have been waiting, seeing as I’d contacted them in advance; they were both waiting for me in the living room instead of training. Nate was beaming.
“Have you arrived?” Hibiki greeted, still with a composed expression.
“Huh? What’s that? What is it?”
Nate’s eyes were fixated on the big paper box that I was holding.
“Something to eat.”
He took the box from me and opened the lid. “Woah! It’s been a long time!”
Inside, ten burgers from his favorite fast-food chain were neatly organized.
Nate’s favorite food was among the things he had eaten in a few days since being rescued from the research center and coming to Korea.
The food remained as warm as if I had just ordered it. This was because I had the snake eat it up before vomiting it back out.
I looked at Nate as I spoke.
“I’m surprised you’ve grown so tall in a short time… Did you gain weight as well?”
Nate’s body, which had been small and skinny compared to his age at the time of the rescue, had now begun to find a shape suitable for his age. It had done so with the speed of several times that of normal people, just as a Hunter’s flesh should be.
Considering that, however, the meat on his cheeks was unusual. For a hunter whose body tended to find its efficient shape as the active Mana increased, it meant that he had eaten up ridiculous amounts of calories until now.
Hibiki confirmed this.
“People who came to help us began to doubt us. Even if they filled up five restaurant-class refrigerators with groceries and food, there weren’t any leftovers. They asked themselves if we were hosting a free feeding program in this house for all the people in the neighborhood.”
Even if he had gotten fat now, he would return to normal if he did a round in the dungeon.
Nate picked up a burger and offered it to us.
“Let’s eat!”
“I already ate before coming here.”
“Hibiki, how about you?”
“No, Nate. Thank you.”
Like in the past, when only three of us were together, we communicated in English. Of course, Nate had no problem with this, and Hibiki’s English proficiency wasn’t the same as in the previous life, but she also had no problem communicating. It was a big deal that a Japanese person who had only gone through primary education could practice this pronunciation and grammar level. She was sharp in her senses, but she naturally was brilliant.
In addition to this, Hibiki would absorb anything faster from the things she learned from now on than she did before. She had been born with the intellect, and now she even had a unique skill that could easily overpower others’.
“By the way, this is a franchise that does not have a store in Asia yet. Did you get this from the U.S.? Then… Did the snake eat it and vomited out?”
Hibiki already knew of the abilities of the black snake.
I nodded awkwardly, and a shadow was cast on her face.
“Then, was that stored in the same place as the things that they usually ate?”
Hibiki had not seen the snake eating a human yet, but she saw it eating another thing.
She must have recalled the scene of five giant-sized snakes, each eating a whole pig; and she looked as if she had lost her appetite. I knew she imagined that the burger box had been mixed in with those meat chunks.
The space inside the stomach of the snake was a type of sub-dimension, so I tried to explain that it was not of the structure she was worried about. Still, Nate, who was already hurriedly munching down the burgers with his inflated cheeks, spoke back in a tone to ask what the big deal was about it.
“Hmm? What’s wrong with that?”
*
Bringing Nate, who easily finished ten burgers in his seat, and Hibiki, who ended up not even taking a bite, we headed to the Sunken Garden, which was connected to the 1st basement floor.
Nearly four months had already passed since the day of reincarnation. The season now entered early autumn, and the wind was cool while the sun remained hot.
By going through the basement floor door, the garden we entered was open to the outside, but due to and no sound could leak out.
It was a training ground specially prepared for the two.
“Well, shall we check your assignments?”
Nate shouted cheerfully in reply. “Okay! I’ll go first.”
“Alright, show me.”
He quickly settled himself. He concentrated his mind and stared at the garden in front of him.
I could see the Mana slightly clouding in front of his eyes. This was not even a skill, but a way for any trained hunter to handle their own Mana.
The active Mana stimulated the hunter’s strengthened body. Nate’s gaze was much sharper than usual, capturing everything that could not normally be seen.
“Wow, I’ve already got so many of them before, and they already gathered like this again?”
He was looking at mosquitoes hiding in the grass because the sun was still out.
“How many are there?”
“About 20 of them in my sight.”
He would be able to see more if he used [Penetration], but he hadn’t learned such skills yet.
He had used his ability purely with the control of Mana, and this was a big deal, considering the training period.
Sweat dripped down Nate’s forehead. He then asked, “Should I catch them?”
“Okay, get them.”
He concentrated Mana to the tip of his finger and scattered it forward.
Swoosh!
A pale blue membrane was now visible only to Nate and me.
It brushed against other objects as if they were simply passing through and disappeared by making small flashes of lightning throughout the bush as he intended.
Pat!
Papat!
In each of those places, tiny creatures fell off as pesticides hit them.
Meanwhile, I could see a much more detailed and clear picture than Nate was seeing.
Instead of crushing the mosquitoes completely, he gave the Mana waves by creating a finely coordinated shock that killed them. The weak body of a mosquito that burst just by pressing it with fingers had its tissues almost intact.
‘That’s way more than I imagined. Natural talent never goes away.’
I recalled Nate’s condition when I first met him.
It had been quite a while since he had Awakened, so the Mana was somewhat activated, but he was still behind on the aspect of Mana Control. It was bound to happen since he did not have a teacher.
Because of this, the first assignment I gave Nate was to practice how to handle it elaborately. All his training had now paid off.
“Then, how about you do the next one?”
Nate was reluctant to do the second homework at first. I remembered his reaction.
‘What did you say, Jin-Wook? Do I have to do that? I don’t like bugs. Do we have to make the bugs as friends?’
I wondered if the institute had ever dealt with measles because of bugs, but soon I felt that this was not the case. They would have thoroughly maintained sanitation for the control of the experiment environment.
Listening to him, Nate’s deep disgust and hatred toward bugs were due to the intense experience he had within his memory before he was kidnapped.
In other words, it was a kind of trauma.
‘There’s nothing good about bugs! When I try to sleep at night, they make noises nearby, make my skin itchy, my skin got irritated because of their bites··· They hide under the leftover pizza I ate the day before and they surprise you, lay eggs in the bathroom. If there are dead animals in the street, they eat it by digging in····.’
The streets close to the slums where he grew up were miserably unhygienic, and Nate seemed to be filled with memories of suffering from insects since he was very young.
‘Especially mosquitoes! Mosquitoes are the worst! Mosquitoes need to be gone from this world!’
For Nate to grow into a true necromancer in the future, he could not stick to the current principle of making only those he liked to be under his control. I felt the need to change his mind.
Otherwise, Nate wouldn’t be able to increase his controlled ones unless the people he liked would die.
In the end, he had to increase his troops in the same way as he had done in the previous life.
I needed to implant a principle that instead of making a being he liked as a friend, he should hunt those who would prove to be harmful if they were kept alive, and then use them as subordinates.
‘Nate, we’re going to explore the dungeons together from now on. Until you get sick of it, we have to hunt more monsters than you can ever imagine. If we don’t, we have to stop the monsters coming out of the collapsed dungeons from the Earth. Then the world outside the lab where you barely came back will collapse.’
‘I understand.’
‘You’re going to kill those who will only cause harm on Earth if they are alive and make them your subordinates. They’re not friends. Why don’t we think about these two as separate things?’
Nate agreed with me.
As a result, the scene unfolding in front of me now ···
Whooooooong!
Mana’s flow from Nate reached the mosquitoes that had fallen throughout the garden, and had now rekindled the tiny creatures with the flames of life.
No, to be exact, they had mutated into something else that wasn’t a living thing.
Weing!
What I wanted to see now was how many subordinates could be produced at a time.
‘Twenty of them, they all turned into zombies.’
The difficulties would differ according to the characteristics of the being, but this level was good enough at current standards.
From now on, in the dungeons, if the monsters were kinds that could be made as subordinates, he would be able to convert twenty of them at once.
Nate gazed at me with eyes that seemed to say, ‘What shall I do with them?’
“Now, should we see the assignment of Hibiki? Nate, command all the zombie mosquitos to fly ‘moderately’ around Hibiki, please.”
Nate nodded and spoke by opening his mouth.
He could command them in his mind, but he told me that it was easier to say it with clear words.
“Fly freely around that area!”
Right then, it came true as he spoke.
‘When Nate manipulates the dead beings, he does not need to control the detailed movements of each object.’
One of the conclusions we had made about his future skills was that even the zombified individual had some judgment or fuzzy logic.
How it performed to commands once they were declared depended on the subject.
More precisely, it meant that something in the subject functioned instead of a damaged brain cell, rather than some of its cognition remaining.
Buzz! Buzz!
Mosquitoes began to fly around Hibiki in their own manner to replicate the movements before their death.
Unlike the living mosquitoes, which flew a little and had to rest again, Nate’s Mana was burned and used as an energy source. They could fly around without catching a break.
‘One needs a different skill to calculate each flight path of the twenty subjects in one’s head. Nate doesn’t have that ability.’
However, this was possible for Hibiki.
“Hibiki?”
She nodded and closed her eyes as if she was concentrating.
As for her training in [Multiple Cognition], I had no choice but to repeat what I heard from Hibiki herself in the future.
‘Think of it as dividing the room in your head into different sections. And fill each room with completely different ideas all at the same time, without interruption. But the flow of each room is not completely cut off from each other. Each room is complimentary. You’re the only source of the will to control that diversity of thought.’
It was an awkward experience to repeat what I myself didn’t fully understand.
However, having already encountered [Multiple Cognition]’s unique skill, Hibiki quickly seemed to understand what it meant.
As a result···
Woong!
Hibiki activated a skill.
[Light!]
This was a basic and straightforward skill for magic. However, the movement of the Mana was unusual.
‘Twelve simultaneously?’
Twelve luminous objects that were smaller than a crystal appeared around her simultaneously.
It wasn’t exactly like the original that the skill card guided. She injected her will and modified it. The luminous object was much smaller than the standard light magic. This was the magic that she had drawn simply by controlling her own Mana.
And those twelve were activated at once.
It was of the same process, but she formed 12 Mana patterns simultaneously.
‘But it is closer to having the same thoughts twelve times. It’s like dividing the calculator into 12 and giving the same for it to perform.’
From now on was the important part.
Weing!
Boong!
According to my command, Hibiki leaked out her Mana. Then, each of the 12 luminous objects drew a light trajectory, following each of the zombie mosquitos. It didn’t attach itself too near or too far, marking a fixed distance between.
To make a magical sphere did not equal a nerve interaction like a simple finger movement.
Each trajectory properly passed through the brain, establishing proper judgment.
Therefore, the scene in front of my eyes was proof that Hibiki’s cognitions, divided into twelve, were each performing a different process.
“Alright, that’s enough.”
The results of the two were satisfactory.
The light disappeared, and the mosquitos lost their movements, falling into the bushes at my signal.
“If it’s about this much, the basic training is over. Then….”
Nate stole my words as if he knew what I was going to say. “Then, finally?!”
“Yes.”
Both of them had completed their Hunter registration ever since they came to Korea. I ordered Nate to come out with a moderate E-Rank, and Hibiki, who was newly Awakened, to naturally come out with an E-Rank without manipulating it.
It had only been a month since then.
Nate developed a lot in that short time, but Hibiki also grew faster than Nate in terms of Mana’s activation and control.
‘It’s going to be a lot different from the results of then.’
“Shall we go into the dungeon soon? But before that, let’s get a promotion test first.”
And this time…
“With me.”
I was going to apply for my promotion test, as well.
*
“Oh, Team Leader!”
Secretary Kim was again on holiday, which was why he did not go to the guild.
He kept it as a secret from the Celestial Dragon Guild that he would meet me.
“Oh, thank God. You’re alright!”
“I’ve been well.”
His smile was full of color. There were eyes that could not be expressed in words. However, there was an underlying emotion as well.
“How are things going on?”
I had already heard the broad story, but I couldn’t help asking again.
