– Be cautioned that the gate that connects to this dungeon closes automatically without using a key.
“Hurrah!” Nate joyfully yelled to the top of his lungs.
Hibiki, who was already on the verge of a Potion shock, collapsed on the floor. She, who always remained composed, must have been quite shaken, as she leaked an empty smile, this time, saying, ‘Haha… Ha…!”
‘They’ve done well.’
It was a battle close to the two’s limit. I had constantly observed and cared for them, but they’d faced a threat to their life several times. This experience must have been a stepping stone to a large growth for both of them.
And then.
– To all users who have contributed to preventing the dungeon break will be rewarded accordingly.
The gate would close by itself, and the boundaries had not been weakened, so the key to the dungeon was not given. All we could get was extra compensation. No matter how powerful the four major guilds may have been, the reason why they volunteer to make up the first line of defense was here.
‘Among the Break rewards, Hunter doesn’t have to choose from many options.’
The system selects the best option for them to receive within their contribution and gives it to the Hunter.
‘In other words, nobody loses!’
There was a reason why the price of the items worldwide fell exponentially after suppressing a dungeon break. Since all of them who participated would be given a definite reward based on their contribution, they become less rare.
– The user contribution ranking is No. 1 (contribution rate: 88%)
– Additional rewards are available according to your contribution. Do you want to accept it?
‘This is within my expected range.’
There was only one case in which an individual exceeded 50% of the break contribution rate in a past life. When a break occurred, it was not easy for individuals to make more than half of the contribution rate. As usual, about a thousand Hunters gather to build a defense line. But today, I ended up setting a new record, including all my past and present life.
“I will accept.”
I saw that each compensation appeared in front of Nate and Hibiki. But then.
“Huh?”
Nate asked me as he approached me, “What? Didn’t Jin-Wook get anything?”
I was not baffled by this situation. The phenomenon experienced by a Hunter, who barely passed 50 percent in his previous life, was just unfolding in front of me.
“I’ll take a while.”
The system message that only I hear had been changed to something abnormal from just a moment ago.
– (##################)!
It was a distorted and disturbed system message. I’d experienced this phenomenon before. On the day I Awakened as Seo Jin-Wook. The message now penetrating my mind clearly conveyed some meaning, but I couldn’t understand it right away. It felt like a part of my mind had become clouded.
– (##################)!
But then.
The phenomenon did not last long.
– [The Successor’s Eyes (Rank: EX)] Detects interference with this force.
– Attempt to recover filtered semantic fragments. ···Recovery complete!
The meaning of the system message has now normally flowed into my head a tempo late. The message was actually telling this:
– (A* 150-grade contribution 88% confirmed. Spent time 1 hour, 12 minutes and 45 seconds. ··Error! Error!)
– (According to regulations No. 29-42-19048 ‘Compensation Evaluation Process According to Dungeon Break Response Contribution Rate’ and regulations No. 18-1-00921 ‘Dimensional Item Supply Criteria for Quest Progress Rate,’ a conflict is confirmed.)
– (Decisions to correct this error are beyond the control cognition’s autonomy. Requesting to summon the ministry spirit!)
When I checked the message, I sang joyfully to myself.
‘All right!’
I think what the Hunter in the past life experienced will follow soon. I told the two of them.
“I think I’m going to disappear for a while and then come back. Just like when we were attacking the dungeon.”
The look on the faces of the two people showed they couldn’t understand. According to what they studied, a Hunter doesn’t have to choose break compensation. So, they wouldn’t understand why I was going to be summoned.
“For more information, I’ll explain when I…”
Even before I was done talking…
Swish!
I was summoned there.
‘There you go!’
I was surrounded by darkness in the blink of an eye. It was a space full of dense darkness.
I’d experienced two similar places like this. One was the Altar of Trials that I visited as soon as I Awakened, and the other was the space to select additional rewards after Clearing a dungeon.
However, there was no silver altar here, and there were no white lights that surrounded me like the stars of the night.
‘If I wait like this, I will hear another message again. In a form that anyone can understand.’
However, the message my previous life received here was not general and mechanical telepathy. It was a more ‘human’ message, as I heard when I first Awakened, by the standards of the Earth’s people.
‘To hear such a message means that I will see that being again!’
A few seconds of waiting made my prediction a reality.
Swoosh!
The black air opened, and a woman’s body, glowing blue, appeared—a body shaped with Mana. At the same time, the system message rang.
– I’m sorry to keep you waiting so long. Something unexpected happened. To explain briefly what the user is currently experiencing…
Floating in the dark were screens of different shapes float wrapped around her. The woman-shaped being looks at one of the screens seriously.
I remembered. She called herself the ‘Military Spirit.’ Her eyes widened as if she had found something on the screen. The head turned, and our eyes met. The system message followed the movement of her lips and spoke in my head.
– What, it’s you again?
*
There was a strange silence between us two. What lingered in my eyes now was a little anticipation. On the other hand, there was an explicit feeling of annoyance in the eyes of the Spirit.
– You’re a being of many strange cases in ways. Your name is… Seo Jin-Wook?
This is the first time in history that a system message directly mentioned Hunter’s name. They are usually referred to only as Summoner and User.
‘Does she mean that it’s an exceptional case that she had to check my name? From that Spirit’s point of view, that is.’
However, right after making such a short comment, the Spirit turned its annoyed gaze back to the screen. The wall made of blue Mana was filled with Archid characters. I could simply read them and distinguish the shapes with my knowledge, but there were too many words I didn’t know. They weren’t words that I’d forgotten but were words I never learned in the first place. For now, I made myself store the shapes in my head using [The Successor’s Eyes].
– Anyway, I’m busy, so I’ll explain it quickly and briefly. The reason why you were summoned and why you met me here is simply because I couldn’t give you items that fit your contribution on the break.
I didn’t have to reveal that I had heard all the censored messages, so I quietly listened. This meant that it could not give items with the automated message’s authority or ‘control cognition.’
– Your grades are abnormally high. In the first place, it wasn’t the level of difficulty set for a single individual to get this grade. Anyway, you had a contribution rate of 88%, and the time it took was extremely short, so the expected compensation rating went up very high. But the problem is….
I knew. Whether someone clears the A-class dungeon or blocks the A-class break, the limit of compensation is the next higher grade. The compensation rank limit I can receive is SS-Class. However, according to a different standard from that, it concurred my contribution should be higher than the SS-Class.
‘Because my performance broke through the difficulty they set.’
Something of theirs called the operational regulations were conflicting with each other. I guessed what the Spirit would say.
‘It would say that although it is a grade that is right for me to receive an SSS-Class reward, it is not available by the regulations, right?’
However, the words that returned were not what I expected.
– Items that match your grade cannot be supplied at the dimension where the tutorial is still in progress.
What’s that supposed to mean?
‘It’s different from what the Hunter had heard!’
Although they are of limited amount on Earth, SSS-class items will be released in the past or the present life. Therefore, the item that the Spirit was talking about wasn’t SSS-Class, but a class higher item than that.
‘If it’s after the SSS-Class, it’s the EX-Class!’
In the past life, humankind learned about the concept of EX-class by discovering an EX-class skill. EX-class items had never been found on Earth.
‘Wait a minute, then, if I everything···.’
It wants me to bug off with receiving an SS-Class item instead of receiving an EX-Class item. Contrary to my expectations, the value of items I have to give up had gone up a notch.
– So, I’d like to give you an SS-Class item at the discretion of the power given to me and at the same time give you an additional reward. By any chance, is there anything you are hoping for?
So far, it was in line with the direction I was aiming for. In the first place, I was going to make a deal with the system by increasing my contribution rate abnormally high for this break. However, if the price to give up was an EX-Class item, I think I should have asked for more than I originally planned.
‘No, wait a minute. Before I decide like that!’
Let’s test the water one more time, “If you mean an item that can’t be released in the tutorial, I think you might be referring to an EX-Class.”
– ····You know the concept of it. Yes, that’s right. But I can’t give you this.
“What if I made extra results? Or would it be possible if I overcome ‘the ordeal’?”
The Spirit was determined.
– No, no condition is possible. The principle that one can’t release an EX-Class item in a tutorial is an absolute regulation.
I clicked my tongue inside. Damn! Given the existing case, the thing was impossible once the system message said that it was impossible.
‘By the looks of it, it looks that it is annoyed to death. I should get what I can scrape up from this as much as possible before I agitate her even more with the EX-Class item.’
Therefore, I threw a deal that was a steep upgraded from the request I had originally prepared.
“Right now, among humankind, SSS-Class items are valued for ten or more SS-Class items. Then, EX-Class could be valued as 10 of SSS-Class items, right?”
– No, wait a minute. Stop there. That’s hard. I understand what you’re trying to say.
I went on without caring about it, “Then, in the condition that I would receive an SS-Class item instead of the EX-Class item, I’d like to receive 100 of them, by my choice.”
Unless the word ‘never’ was mentioned, I had to give it a go.

chapters.title: Chapter 73
chapters.content:
Deal (2)
The ministry spirit sighed.
– Sigh…
She shook her head and said,
– You people, the desire of the mortal, is a very hard concept to understand. Why the hell are you so eager for?
For what? To survive, to be prepared. Seeing that it was classifying humans as mortals, did this mean that the spirit’s identity was immortal? I wasn’t sure, but I was a little upset to hear that.
‘Well, whatever I may feel like, I just have to get what I need.’
I asked as if to hurry her up, “What do you think? I think it’s a fairly fair and reasonable deal.” I was saying it with much boldness wrapped around my face. In fact, the story I just told her was a lie. Well, not a complete lie, but rather my subjective valued judgment? There is no conventional understanding or an international agreement that 10 SS-Class items were equivalent to one SSS-rated item.
I just said it without any basis.
‘In the beginning, there is no record of SSS-Class items being traded in this era just yet.’
Even though I knew for certain that what would return is a rejection, there was a good reason to risk it.
‘This should be the first and last time someone can make a deal like this in return for stopping a dungeon break below A-Class!’
A Hunter, who had similar experiences in my previous life, said that the system message added him a hint. That wouldn’t include any additional benefits for him in the future because of the gap in compensation at a difficulty lower than A-Class. In other words, to try this kind of deal again, he had to show similar performance on the breaks above the S-Class next time, which was next to impossible.
‘I had to do everything I could this time!’
The spirit looked at the Mana screen in front of her with a look of great annoyance. A few subsequent gestures follow. The diagram and Archid characters inside were quickly rearranged and create strings of texts like flowing water. Considering the general process, and ignoring the unknown words, was…
‘It’s kind of a simulation.’
The screen that the spirits see seemed to be connected to the ‘system.’ Assuming a situation in which 100 SS-class items were given to one Awakened, it checked the result of it.
‘It’s too lazy to argue with me, so she’s doing the math right away.’
The result came out immediately. The Archid word that popped up was very easy, so I understood it right away.
‘Impossible.’
The spirit spoke determinedly.
– What you asked for is an excessive reward. 100 SS-Class items are not of the same value as 1 EX-Class item. In the first place, item classes are not calculated by simple mathematics, and the criteria you gave are calculated to be accepted among the natives of that dimension, right? It’s impossible to impose a 100:1 value comparison here.
This much of the response was expected. I knew it wouldn’t work, so I just did it. I didn’t have to bend down from the beginning. Now it’s time to listen to the other party’s suggestion.
“Then, to what extent is it possible?”
– As suggested in the beginning, one SS-Class item, and if you tell me about the additional requirements, I will review them and accept the available ones.
She was robbing me. I clicked my tongue inside, ‘Rather than it only being able to do so… It’s just lazy for her to give me this and that!’
With the personality, I have encountered so far and concluding from the data that piled up, later on, the ministry spirit’s attitude was like a bureaucrat who was tired of excessive work and tried to resolve as possible.
‘That doesn’t mean that I have to back off immediately.’
The more I annoyed her, the more likely I’d get what I want. That was how they work every time.
“If 100 is too much. Let’s go with 50.”
Then the spirit’s eyes were filled with explicit emotions. If I had to put it in words, this would be the right description for it. She thought I was a pain in the backside.
– Ah…. Seriously…
She frowned heavily, but she couldn’t kick me out right away.
‘Only when she is done giving me the reward, by any means, and has to agree on the reward, could she get out of this place too!’
The guess turned to conviction.
– Wait a minute.
She didn’t even pretend to think or contemplate. Instead of finding a way, she immediately entered something on the screen and interpreted the result. After a few attempts were repeated several times:
– 10 SS-Class items. I recommend that you be satisfied with this much. How is that?
I had already checked the screen that the spirits saw, so I knew that there was still room for that counteroffer, even if I didn’t understand it 100%. I hit it back without delay.
“20 SS-Class items. All of them by my designation. And an additional request apart from the item.”
If she reduced 100 from 50 to 20, it was natural that she should pay a corresponding price.
– I’m not accepting the offer yet, but I’d like to hear what the additional requests are before we go further.
“When the tutorial is over, I know it’s possible to upgrade your unique skill or change them to a completely different kind.”
– How do you know that? That’s strange. That information can’t have been announced at this dimension yet.
“I have been in contact with an alien race who have been wandering in various dimensions.”
– ···So?
“My tutorial is not over yet, but I want to upgrade my unique skill at this point.”
Whether it was [Mana Drain] or [The Successor’s Eyes], it was a bigger win than acquiring a decent SS-Class item if any of the two’s performance could be increased.
But then.
– Impossible.
The spirit refused immediately without looking at the screen. I was calm because it was the reaction I had expected.
‘Supplying an EX-Class item is impossible. Upgrading my unique skill is impossible. What they have in common is that it’s not a choice until the tutorial is over.’
I asked, “You’re saying the end of the tutorial is such an important reference point? If so, even if I don’t upgrade it right away, can I know in advance what options exist in the future?”
The spirit sighed lightly.
– I’m not assigned to you in the first place. Compensation that I can give you can only be made within my authority.
I immediately changed my requirements, “Well, what about this?” So far, I’ve been requesting, well knowing that it would be impossible. But from now on, there was something that I was determined to receive.
“I want all the information about an Awakened with a unique skill called [Mercadius’ Seed].”
She made a strange face.
– ···If it has a skill of that name in the first place, the being wouldn’t be from your dimension.
It was consistent with the explanation of the immortal.
– In any case, I can’t access or intervene with someone’s unique skill. I don’t have the authority. The person in charge of that case will not be involved in this dimension until the tutorial is finished.
“Then let’s change the terms. I want information about an alien species that came to Earth at least before 2023 and had direct or indirect contact with me.”
Fifteen years ago, the original Seo Jin-Wook first experienced the symptom of the curse, so there was no need to consider those who had come to Earth since then. If the range was reduced as much as possible, it was focused under this condition.
“I am aware. The information about the Awakened of the dimension where the tutorial is in progress is protected.”
She wouldn’t answer if someone asks the ministry spirit for my information at the Altar of Trials.
But then.
“The name of the skill [Mercadius’ Seed] has a proper noun and means it has already been modified, right? The being I’m looking for must have completed the tutorial quest and should not be subject to information protection, yes?”
The spirit stared at me for a moment without saying a word. And, there was a slight frown between her eyes.
– I can’t refute that. You really know a lot of things.
And whispers softly.
– Oh, that’s a real hassle.
That doesn’t mean it’s impossible. There we go!
– But I can’t give you all the information you want. It’s not my authority in the first place. I can extract a list of the Awakened beings who have already completed the tutorial, and their current location, which visited Earth before 2023. Do you accept?
That alone was a huge step forward. Since I was making a breakthrough with the situation where I had no idea where the curse originated, I wanted to know at least. However, I wanted to sing for the joy of it.
‘Before I put an end to it, I should get what I can.’
I didn’t mean to be satisfied with only this, “Then, 20 SS-Class items and the information of the Awakened according to the conditions I suggested. Do you agree?”
– No, wait a minute. I think you’re mistaken now, but I didn’t accept the condition of 20 items in the first place. Wait a minute.
She looked at the simulation again on the screen and said,
– Not 20. 10 for SS-Class. You can’t adjust the amount of the item any further.
That wasn’t a lie, but it wasn’t solely the truth. There is still room for this offer. If I could manipulate the item, I could ask for something else.
“Well, I suggest it again.”
Now there was a look on the face of the ministry spirit that seemed to say, ‘What a disgusting human being!’ A sickening look. I said without hesitation, “10 SS-Class items. Provide the information I requested. Add one more… Give me the authority to receive the ‘Selection quest.’”
– ·······Have you heard the concept of the selection quest from the alien being?
I lied, “Yes, I have.” The concept of a quest was unfamiliar to humankind now, but in fact, all hunters were still performing the same kind of quest. The quest was named ‘Tutorial.’
‘Tutorial quests are quests shared by all hunters.’
The content was simple. When a dungeon opened, clear it, block the brakes, and become stronger. Everyone forgets because it didn’t provide an exact target, but we are all currently conducting the quest at this moment.
‘However, from the latter part of the tutorial quest, only a select few hunters would experience additional challenges.’
The system classified them as ‘chosen’ when they show outstanding capabilities and performance compared to other hunters. Such an Awakened is entitled to receive and perform quests shared only with individuals or minorities. If one succeeded, the individual gets a reward that others can’t get from an ordinary dungeon.
‘For example, the dagger that Angelica held in her previous life. Becoming Angelica’s attributed item, it was the only item that could break the dimensional bird’s egg and as a reward for finishing a personal quest.’
Come to think of it now. Angelica must have completed the quest and taken the dagger to gain control of the egg.
‘Since it’s a personal item, no one could break it as long as Angelica is determined not to break the egg. She created a situation where someone had to kill Angelica to take the knife away.’
Before that, she killed everyone on the other way around.
‘I need to be qualified before others for it to be advantageous.’
The spirit hesitated for a moment.
– That’s…
“Is that impossible too? It’s going to be in the tutorial anyway. Isn’t it a different story from EX-Class items and unique skill modifications?”
-That’s true, but I was thinking of starting the screening quest in a few years in this dimension. If I open the quest to only one person in advance…
She would not say that it was against fairness. In the first place, tutorial quests were made up to become stronger and weak ones would be left behind the wall.
The following words were as I expected.
– ········ getting a little annoying.
“It’s not impossible, is it?”
The spirit, looking at the screen, suddenly startled and screamed.
– Wait a minute!
It seems that it had noticed something.
– Oh, my God. Have I been here this long?! How long has it been?
I think it’s been less than 10 minutes from my point of view. But the spirit was frightened and fed up by it.
– Yes, yes, okay! All right! Let’s wrap it up here. 10 SS-Class items, information about an Awakened that meets certain conditions, and sharing a screening quest only to you in advance.
She glared at me as if she would not tolerate me anymore.
– Do you agree?
I didn’t think I should play any more tricks, ‘I’ll have to settle for this.’ I nodded my head, “I agree.”
The spirits rushed to type something into the screen.
– Then, we will proceed in reverse order of what you requested. I’ll give you your last request first.
Swish!
A cluster of light, like the stars, poured out of the sky and fell on the back of my hand. A blue flash illuminated and created a pattern on the back of the hand.
‘Mark of the Chosen!’
It was similar to the seal engraved on the body when I Awakened, but it was different. This is a kind of a secondary Awakening. I received the certification to access a kind of a main quest within the tutorial quest. As soon as I looked at it, I heard an automated message. It was not a ministry spirit, but the control cognition.
– A total of 108 quests are currently available for the user.
At this moment, I was the only one who could access this quest list on Earth.
Said the spirit.
– Now, the next… is an alien being that came over to Earth, right?
She kept grumbling.
– Ah…. This is such a hassle.
At that moment. Weing! The landscape around us changed at once.
‘This is!’ I had a cognitive impairment for a second then… I returned to normal due to the unique skill’s effect, ‘I see it now!’
The thing that suddenly appeared looked like seeing a part of the vast galaxy or the map of neurons that I saw in a book somewhere. Countless dots were spread out, and each of them was connected by a fine line, creating a net-like dense mesh.
I could see for sure what it was, ‘It’s a type of a map!’
It was a three-dimensional map that used all the surrounding spaces. I checked the center of the map that the spirits looked at. On the small dot she stared at, a long Archid text string was arranged, most of which were numbers. And the short word next to the number meant, ‘Earth.’ I felt goosebumps all over my body for a moment.
‘Oh, wait a minute. This thing right now?’
While the spirit was working, I was busy keeping this huge three-dimensional map in my eyes. If what I’m guessing was right…!
– Well, let’s see. That’s a lot more than I thought.
The spirit’s task was to observe the past record of interactions between the interconnected points. For example, the point marked Earth and the other point connected by a line has the word ‘Krashen’ written in Archid characters and the long number next to it. As the spirit gestured, additional text strings appeared above the line, describing the two points’ relationship. A physical passage between the two points was temporarily created in 2021, followed by the description that an Awakened being had crossed from ‘Krashen’ to ‘Earth.’
And before the Awakened crossed to Krashen, it was in another dimension connected to it, and the name of the dimension and the number beside it was clearly stated. There were several other similar cases.
‘I see!’
I understood the identity of the huge map that the spirit was looking at now.
‘This was a map of the coordinates and names of all dimensions… around the Earth!’

chapters.title: Chapter 74
chapters.content:
Encounter
It seemed the ministry spirit even imagined that I could see this map and could remember it flawlessly. Frankly, right after the 3-dimensional map appeared, it was hard to recognize it since my mind was clouded. Of course, thanks to [The Successor’s Eyes], it came back to me in no time.
‘So, it is true that the unique skill of an Awakened cannot be opened.’
At that moment, possibilities pass through my mind.
‘Wait, if that’s so!’
I recalled the SSS-Class item that I received, as an additional reward, after Clearing Siheung 8 Dungeon. [Door of Hope]. The artifact was said to be prepared by the Emperor of the Sebrarian Empire for interdimensional evacuation. I gave up the last time I tried to activate it because I did not have a way to input the exact coordinates. And when I tried to input a random coordinate, the response was that it required an unbelievable amount of Mana.
‘But then, what about the case of a nearby dimension?’
The map that the Ministry Spirit was looking at didn’t seem to contain every single existing dimension. Still, it was a tremendous amount, even only for dimensions near to Earth.
‘What if I input these coordinates in the [Door of Hope]?’
Thanks to the Ministry Spirit, I scored an unexpected victory.
‘I can definitely make good use of this!’
In the early stages of the tutorial, the contact with alien races was minimal, but as the quest progressed, the exchange with nearby dimensions became more frequent. The two dimensions that met each other would relationships, whether friendly, neutral, or hostile. The only passage that the Awakens could travel through the two dimensions was dungeons that had collapsed.
‘That common idea can completely be invalidated!’
The possibility of traveling even to a dimension not connected to a dungeon…
‘If I have to fight with the aliens who were the enemies of Earth. The possibilities of the usage, including spying, ambush, extortion, and assassinations, make it limitless.’
The key was how much core was needed to get to the nearest dimension. Right after memorizing everything, the Ministry Spirit spoke to me.
– Now, the list is as follows.
My eyes were widened by the hologram she opened.
“You’re saying there are that many of them?”
– Yes, it was quite peculiar. Somehow, many of the alien races that were through with the tutorial seem to be interested in this dimension.
She suggested that an Awakened, from a dimension where the tutorial had ended, had visited Earth before I got cursed.
“And all the more, you’re saying that all of them are still on Earth, right?”
– Yes. Looking at their behavioral patterns, I believe some are assigned there with the mission of spying.
Before I heard the Spirit’s words, I was also prepared for the possibility that the perpetrator had gone back to its dimension so there would be no more way to track it down. But their current location, as indicated on the list, was unexpected. Every one of them was still living on the Earth!
‘One or more among them may definitely be related to the curse.’
I had to feel even more ridiculous while I looked closer on the list.
‘While there are aliens hiding without contact with humans, there are aliens who are boldly disguised as humans!’
Some of them were strangers that I’d never heard of in my entire life.
‘What, this guy was an alien?!’
There was also a mix of very famous top-tier hunters. I had never encountered them in my previous life. This was because they went mysteriously missing shortly after Angelica appeared in the world.
‘Could the reason they disappeared so suddenly was because they came into contact with Angelica? Then there’s a good chance these Hunters aren’t the source of the curse. The Awakened that achieved the state to modify a living thing and upgrade the unique skill can’t be considered weaker than the immortal.’
I had one unanswered question. Why did the so-called great alien that stayed on the Earth for a long time let Angelica be in my previous life?
Or… was that situation also intended?
‘I couldn’t find an answer just by thinking alone. I didn’t have any leads.’
Based on the list I’d now obtained, I would find a clear answer if I followed where they lead.
– Well, I’ve given you a list. Next is the item.
“Yes, I’ll tell you what I want.” I calmly recited the list of artifacts. I did not mention the items that I was sure I knew which dungeon I needed to Clear to get my hands on. The ones that I demanded now either had insufficient quantity released, or I’d seen an alien race that used it but was never supplied, on the Earth, in my previous life.
As it was quickly typing down the list I dictated, the Ministry Spirit paused for a moment.
– ······Hold on. You want me to give you five of [Renace’s Ring]?
“The condition was 10 of SS-Class items, not of 10 kinds. You did not mention that it’s not allowed for me to request for multiple quantities of the same item.”
That was a necessary item. In the past life, the alien race that was hostile to the Earth had it, and the strongest of them was wearing it, so we had a lot of trouble.
– Hmm… I can’t do this.
She came out harder than I thought. I tried to protest because it sounded like she was breaking a promise, but I couldn’t help but listen to what followed.
– We only have two of these in stock now.
In stock? It was a word containing many facts. Did it mean that even the system cannot just print out the items as many times as it wished?
“If there is a concept of stock, is there a concept of production as well?”
– It’s something I can’t mention.
She was keeping her mouth shut again, not revealing critical information.
– Once again, a total of 7 items, including the other items and 2 of [Renace’s Ring], can be provided right now. What would you like to do with the other three?
If this happened, this was out of my calculations. I thought about it for a while and made a decision. Okay, let’s hand over the remaining three to the Spirit and the system.
‘Come to think of it, neither [Stardust Wing] nor [Door of Hope] were items that were unknown to have existed. Artifacts that have never been found in my previous life, but they have tremendous performance.’
What they had in common were certain words that appeared in item descriptions.
‘I’m sure there are other items like this. The problem is I don’t know their names.’
But the system would know. Since it was going in this direction, I decided to give it a try.
“I plan to leave the other three to the system.”
– ···Hmm? That’s unexpected. Well, okay. Then for me, I could easily…
“No, wait a minute. There’s a condition,” The Spirit looked at me with a nonchalant expression, “I’ll request 3 of SS-Class items which have the keywords of ‘Sebrarian Empire’ in the item description. When objectively analyzed, it must be of an equal or better performance from [Stardust Wings].”
This was somewhat of a gamble. It left open the interpretation of equal or of better performance to the system.
‘Come on, surprise me.’
– ·······Sebrarian Empire. Oh, my. I feel like I’m starting to hate you since you’re trying to get the best of me.
Hearing that, I thought I was going in the right direction. The Archid text on the screen waved, and the conditions I was talking about seemed to be entered.
And the result immediately came up.
– Here you go.
There were ten lights in front of me. My choice acquired seven items, and the system selected three items. All of them were SS-Class.
– Sigh. Whenever I meet Mr. Seo Jin-wook, it takes too much of my time. I’ve got a lot of work to do right now, and I can’t believe I’m stranded on this one dimension for such a long time.
That being called the Spirit must have been dealing with a large amount of work; whenever it opened its mouth, it was always of the same story.
She glanced at me and said,
– I hope we won’t meet again like this.
I answered with talent, “Next time, I’ll see you after I’ve stopped an S-Class break.”
– ·······hmph.
The darkness parted, and her figure disappeared, indicating she had had enough of me. Suddenly…
Whiz!
I came back to the dungeon in a flash.
“Jin-Wook!” Nate’s eyes widened.
“What did you pack up so much?”
“Take this first!”
I handed Nate the small items I’d received this time.
“What is this?”
“Hold on to it for now. And Hibiki!”
“Yes!”
What I threw at her was one of the two [Renace’s Ring] I’d received.
[Renace’s Ring (Rank: SS)]
Item Description: A ring that reduces the user’s Mana consumption by 30%.
※ Even if items with the same function are worn together, the effects are not overlapped, and only the item with the most significant effect is applied.
Item effects are similar to the devil’s sword, the [Devil Slayer].
Items that reduce Mana consumption.
This artifact was valuable because it was applied, by any method, whether it was the sword energy, magic, psychokinesis, or unique skill.
‘In fact, it’s the same effect as increasing the Mana capacity.’
If Hunter had finished the Mana activation and couldn’t increase the total Mana by training, he or she has no choice but to rely on these items.
‘Later on, everyone would go crazy, even about artifacts that have a 10% reduction. To have 30%…’
The larger the basic Mana capacity, the more efficient these items are. I put the other of the two rings on my empty finger.
– Active Mana: 72,800 (+34,700)/38,100
– Potential Mana: 139,700
‘There are 70,000 active Mana now… but no matter what skill I use, only 70% of Mana will be consumed, so it’s the same as having 90,000.’
On top of that, it is a great synergy considering the amplification effect of the sword energy by the devil’s sword.
“Hibiki. What are you doing? Put it on. It’s an artifact that reduces your Mana consumption,” I urged Hibiki, who hesitated for some reason.
“Ah! I see. Yes.”
It was more efficient for her than Nate since she was equipped with a 50,000 Mana capacity after activation. After distributing the items, I fed the rest of the items to the snake. A noticeable change was happening to the red burning gate.
“Now they’re crawling in. They’re too slow.”
The government, which had been watching the situation outside, ordered them to enter only after seeing the break termination message.
*
Two Hunters came through the gate. It was Seo Moon-Ga-In, of the Destructional Blade Guild, and Lee Dong-Hyun of the Gate Keepers. The two were dismayed and stiffened by the scene in front of them.
“W-w-w-What on earth is this!” The stuttering Seo Moon-Ga-In struggled for words.
Lee Dong-Hyun looked around the inside of the dungeon with a keen eye. Looking at them, I thought.
‘They should be dumbfounded.’
Soon after the break, the hunters would have confirmed their contributions. No matter what they think about it, they’d notice that the figures were weird.
‘Even if they caught a giant who ran out of the gate by groups, the individual Hunter’s contribution should be 1%. In reality… Must it be 0.01% at best?’
Unless they are fools, they would have noticed what happened. The truth that there were more monsters than they’d seen, as with other breaks. But they would realize the majority of the monsters were destroyed by someone instead of the four guilds that formed the first defense line.
“Oh, my God!”
Charred and chopped up corpses of plague giants covered the ground. The three of us stood in the middle of the endless sea of death.
Seo Moon-Ga-In and Lee Dong-Hyun noticed us. Our gaze crossed. Seo Moon-Ga-In recognized my face and exclaimed, “···Seo Jin-Wook!” The following words were beyond my comprehension.
“You were in Korea?!”
*
I didn’t give them enough time to watch the scene closely. The impressive scene of the giant corpses extending endlessly was enough.
‘I’d burned them with the breath, but if they look closely, they’ll notice a hole where the core was supposed to be.’
Seo Moon-Ga-In repeated the same thing several times with an incredulous expression, “This break, by three of you… Only three of you killed these mountains of monsters?!”
I answered calmly and brazenly, “Yes, that’s right.”
At the same time, I thought, ‘Yes, you guys are the witnesses. You’ve clearly witnessed the achievement that is close to a miracle, that only three of us stopped it, with your own eyes.’
The system message rang.
– Soon, the gate will close.
I told both Nate and Hibiki, “Let’s go back to Earth before the door closes. We’re not sure if the returning stone will work in the collapsed dungeon, are we? Farming is impossible under these circumstances anyway.”
By ordering Nate beforehand, we left the Mana cores of a few bodies nearby. Lee Dong-Hyun, who was looking around, murmured in a slightly suspicious tone.
“That’s… Right.”
Seo Moon-Ga-In sighed.
“It’s tough to believe, but seeing it with my eyes like this, I have to admit it. Did you sneak in through the first line of defense? But it would be considered as direct insubordination ignoring the government’s instructions. They’ll need an explanation.”
“Don’t worry, the explanation will not be made to the four major guilds, but by the Hunter Management department as they hold the commanding power.”
The answer was already ready. Furthermore, as a result, it was the right choice to stop the giants in the dungeon. If so many giants had poured into the Earth, of course, the plague would have raged.
“Come on, let’s go back.”
*
Among the hunters of the first line of defense, a shock-induced chill flowed into the atmosphere as they saw Hibiki, Nate, and I, suddenly coming out of the gate. The first to recognize me was the Celestial Dragon Guild members.
“What, Seo Jin-Wook?! Why is he coming out of there!”
Lee Dong-Hyun explained to everyone while scratching his head, “Oh, oh, I can’t believe it even with my own eyes. I think these three have stopped the rest of the monsters. What we saw inside was.”
As they were being explained to, the Hunters’ faces were distorted by the facts, and their complexions changed color. At the end of Lee Dong-Hyun’s words, Kim Kyung-Rok, the Guild Master of Grand Croix, shouted in an unfriendly tone.
“That’s why our contribution is this way!” He pointed at me and shouted, “This is an act of complete disregard for the government’s command! Do you believe that in the first place, those three stopped the break? It must have been a prank by the Celestial Dragon. Isn’t it that they prepared an SS-Class item that no one knew? By abnormal means to monopolize contribution!”
Then, a man cut through the crowd and came to me at a rapid pace.
“Hey, wait! Seo Gyu-Cheol! Explain this!”
But Seo Gyu-Cheol didn’t answer back and didn’t even bother to look back. He walked toward me, glaring at me with his eyes, step by step with weight. And as he stood in front of me, he spoke in a whisper, “We finally met.” His gaze was that of a man unprepared to give anything away.

chapters.title: Chapter 75
chapters.content:
Seo Gyu-Cheol
Meanwhile, Seo Gyu-Cheol was approaching the crowd from far away. I whispered to the devil’s sword in my hand in a way that would not be heard by anyone around me, “You,” It did not answer me immediately, “Are you ignoring me?”
This had been the case ever since it signed an unfair contract in favor of me. Since the hope of brainwashing me or enticing me has wholly disappeared, it didn’t waste its energy on me. It was probably planning to wait silently for the day when my life would be over.
‘It’s okay to wait, but I never allowed you to ignore what I say.’
I said with strength added to my voice, “Did you forget about the contract already? Why don’t we go home and light the furnace again today?”
‘········Yes, yes. Did you call me? Mister master,’ it said in a sarcastic tone.
I quickly ordered a few things in a low voice, “Okay? We start right away when I give you the signal.”
It couldn’t disobey my instructions no matter what its attitude might be. The moment I finished speaking, Seo Gyu-Cheol stopped.
“We finally meet.”
After deliberately arguing and running away from his office, this was the first time we’d faced each other like this. He spoke in a voice that was as repressed as a man who hadn’t crapped in days, in contrast to the flames blazing in his eyes, “Let’s go somewhere quiet and talk.”
The tone had changed slightly from a few months ago, and I felt a strange sense of distance.
I nodded my head, “Let’s.”
I looked at Nate and Hibiki. It was an expected situation, so they knew how to act and merely nodded.
Seo Gyu-Cheol took a scroll out of his arms. I read the Mana pattern in advance.
‘Of all days, he prepared it for today. No, it would be appropriate to assume that he had it in his possession for any moment like this to come.’
He was about to tear it up when Kim Kyung-Rok shouted, “Hey, you bastards! Can’t you hear me? I said to explain, what the hell is ….”
Seo Gyu-Cheol said in a cold voice, “What you are complaining about, the Management will handle. Shut up before I pull your tongue out.”
“W-what, what? We’ve been letting him be, and that bastard’s crossing the line now!”
Kim Kyung-Rok, who was insulted at the gathering of the four major guilds, reddened with anger. Ignoring him, Seo Gyu-Cheol turned to face the Celestial Dragon Guild members.
“I’m going to talk to my son for a while now that the break is over. No.1 Team Leader, I’ll leave it to you to finish and aftercare.”
“Ah…. Yes!”
Team Leader Yoon Ho-Min nodded with a puzzled expression. Seo Gyu-Cheol tore the scroll without hesitation.
[Wide Range Teleport!]
I relaxed my resistance and left myself to the light that surrounded me.
‘Yeah, there’s too many eyes here.’
When it came to avoiding the place, our opinions agreed. After a while, we were in the middle of the woods. It was apparent that he had entered the coordinates beforehand. I thought he would talk right away, but unexpectedly, Seo Gyu-Cheol kept his mouth shut and only stared at me.
But then…
‘Yes, that was the gaze.’
I could tell by the experience of dealing with my companions, Park Chang-Hee and Han-Seol, that the pupil distorts with a strange glow when intense emotions are shown.
I opened my mouth first and spoke in a deliberate calm tone, “I saw it on TV.”
“You looked for me anxiously.”
I pointed out his irrational behavior and excessive emotions shown in the process. Would Seo Gyu-Cheol be aware of himself?
“It wasn’t like you, father, to turn the media around like you usually do.”
Did he know he was involved in a curse-induced madness? The original Seo Jin-Wook objectively recognized his condition, but Han-Seol and Park Chang-Hee were encroached entirely and did not notice it. What about Seo Gyu-Cheol?
“That’s funny,” He said in a low voice.
“Father?”
“Other guys can fool me, but you can’t,” his fierce eyes flashed. He says in a scratchy voice, “You, what the hell are you?”
A sharp and cold wind blew in the distance between the two of us. I brood over the meaning of what he said. To be honest, it was a surprise. Did this mean that parents could notice? With the affection and instinct by blood?
‘However, looking at Seo Gyu-Cheol’s usual attitude, I couldn’t find the least amount of fatherly love.’
I denied it for now.
“I don’t understand what you mean.”
“You want me to say it again? I asked what the hell you are. Where did you come from, and why are you taking over my son’s body!”
I clicked my tongue inside. He spoke in a confident tone that suggested he knew I was not the original one.
“The reason why you were in such a hurry to find me was because of that misunderstanding?”
“It cannot be a misunderstanding. What the hell are you, with what right do you have… can you do this to the one I’ve been raising so dearly for the last few decades….”
I tried to form a bleak smile. Raised him dearly? From the memories of him or as I experienced in person, he had never cared about Seo Jin-Wook that much.
“···Have you just snatched up the precious seed that has been raised so dearly; it was about to bloom!”
What?
*
My face stiffened at an instant, ‘About to bloom… Seed!’ It was a ubiquitous word. There was nothing strange about those who talk about seeds. However, considering the name and description of the skills that several guild personnel was exposed to, it was an entirely different story.
[Seed of Mercadius (Rank: SSS, Semi-active)]
Skill effect: Interfering with the host’s mind amplifies the most intense desires and emotions and induces thoughts. After its growth, the seed that completely encroaches on the host will bloom, and what will become depends on the intentions of the caster and the characteristics of the host.
Restrictions: The stronger the host’s mental strength and resistance, the slower the seed’s incubation speed, and the risk of the “voice” of the seed being exposed to the host.
‘The probability that Seo Gyu-Cheol would choose those two words without knowing the existence of the skill… What is the probability for such a coincidence?!’
The assumption that Seo Gyu-Cheol was related to the curse was one of the scenarios I had in my head. When my seed destroyed the seeds of Han-Seol and Park Chang-Hee, the memories of the lives of the two people that coagulated there flowed into me.
Since then, I have searched through piles of absorbed memories whenever I have time to explore the common triggers for their madness. Including the original Seo Jin-Wook’s memory in the control group. I hadn’t found the critical scene yet, but I had found some strangeness in an unexpected part.
‘Seo Gyu-Cheol, what the hell is this guy?’
As shown in the memories of the three people, his words and actions were always beyond comprehension. First, Seo Gyu-Cheol, from the original Seo Jin-Wook perspective, was considered emotionless, as he often drove Seo Jin-Wook to the extreme. To start with, shouting at him to overcome a mental illness by will, he repeated the same behavior when he knows that his condition was deteriorating.
Suppose he really wanted to raise his son as the next great leader of the guild and wanted to present him as a poster boy for Celestial Dragon’s honor. In that case, he could have at least pretended to be an exemplary father, but he acted as if he were trying to be the worst father.
Seo Gyu-Cheol, who Han-Seol saw, was also strange. She indeed joined the guild for the original Seo Jin-Wook in the first place, but Seo Gyu-Cheol acquiesced in knowing that she was spending too much private time with his son. When the power of Han-Seol was firmly established in the guild, he left it clear that his son, who he was pushing to be the next Guild Master, was mentally dependent on Han-Seol instead of him.
Seo Gyu-Cheol, reflected in Park Chang-hee’s eyes, was just a stupid man. He kept making Park Chang-Hee and Seo Jin-Wook, who were bitter against each other, together. That’s how he constantly let conflict arise between the two.
Calling Seo Jin-Wook to the meeting, which he did not have to participate in, he also allowed them to go together in the first dungeon after Awakening. It was also Seo Gyu-Cheol who told Park Chang-Hee about Seo Jin-Wook’s training plans in advance.
And in common, Seo Gyu-Cheol… too frequently invited the three, Seo Jin-Wook, Han-Seol, Park Chang-Hee, to his office. Of course, there was a reason behind it. They were each Seo Gyu-Cheol’s son, Assistant Guild Master, and the Exploration Team 2 Leader. Looking back, however, Seo Gyu-Cheol was following the regular interval to gather them. As if…. He was taking time to observe their conditions.
*
I spoke as I glared at him, “[Mercadius’ Seed], did you ever know about it?” I held on to the sword handle.
Seo Gyu-Cheol said with a flash glaring from his eyes, “You mean the seed? Of course! I’m a gardener. A faithful gardener who observes and cultivates the seeds he planted himself… Pledged to harvest a selected crop someday when it blooms to make an offering to him!”
The words contained one truth that could not be ignored. I clenched my teeth, feeling a surge of anger. The way I spoke changed drastically, unbeknownst to me, “Him? And a gardener?”
Seo Gyu-Cheol’s unique skill was not related to brainwashing. It meant he was not the primary source of the curse, but he was connected to an alien.
“Not only did you let the curse be planted, but you also observed that it was eroding properly? Even if you knew I was going crazy because of a curse?”
“What curses! This is baptism!” His eyes had already been tainted with deep madness, “A holy baptism to prepare the offering to be made perfect!”
For what?
“Is that a humane thing to do? To sacrifice your child for whatever the purpose is?”
“The decision to sacrifice one’s children is the noblest sacrifice and the pinnacle of the holy offering! Don’t you know it’s a sacred act that appears in almost all religious scriptures and myths!”
This wouldn’t be solved by talking. I raised my sword.
“You cut in the middle, and everything went wrong. The day your consciousness came back after fainting, I felt a sense of change. That you have finally stopped resisting, given up, and you have begun to accept the will of the seed as your own. Just like Han-Seol and Park Chang-Hee did! But it wasn’t like that. The content has changed!”
Who was he talking about? What was he was trying to get in return for sacrificing his guild members, including his son, and what was the way to offer them?
All these questions… It could be answered by reading his memory.
“You… Are out of the seed’s control! If the seed had manipulated you, you wouldn’t have run away from the gardener on purpose! From now on, I’ll fix everything again!”
Seo Gyu-Cheol took out his sword, and I rushed towards him with several layers of energy wrapped around the sword.
Cling! Clang!
A high-speed battle ensued. Seo Gyu-Cheol’s sword hadn’t lost its sharpness, and he moved instinctively.
But then….
[Artha’s Sword Dance!]
The purple sword energy I poured out clashed with his sword, and instead of scattering directly into the air, it seeped into the blade. The sword energy agglomerated and began to resonate in a particular form.
Clang!
“Keup!”
Seo Gyu-Cheol’s sword broke into pieces before my eyes. His face, as he lost his weapon, turned dark, realizing the disaster. But soon, it was replaced with a look of determination.
Weing!
There was a storm of red Mana around him. His unique skill had been activated.
[Etherification 3333 (Rank: SS)!]
Seo Gyu-Cheol’s whole body, his clothes, and artifacts all seeped into the air, leaving only an instant light shade. This was not just transparency. It was a unique skill that temporarily deviated a limited area around one’s body from the material world.
‘If he runs away like that, it will be the end!’
I deliberately rolled my eyes, missing his image.
‘Even if he deviates from the dimension, it is because of the Mana connected to the material world ···.’
I kept acting. In the ether state, it was possible to pass through objects without being resisted by material, depending on his will. If he seeped into the ground and ran away, I wouldn’t be able to keep up with his speed, and even if I use [Penetration], he’d eventually be out of my sight.
But then….
‘He’s rushing towards me!’
Seo Gyu-Cheol flew to me in the ether state. He didn’t give up on capturing me.
‘He can run away in that condition, but he can’t fight. Since he now lost his weapon, he’ll find a replacement!’
I leave him to come to me. Closing in the ether state, he…
Paht! In an instant, part of his hand was returned to this reality, and he aimed for my wrist with his Mana-wrapped hands.
I responded late to the attack. But the angle of the sword narrowly missed the target, and his attack hit my bone.
Swish!
The sword that fell out of my hand flew into the sky. Seo Gyu-Cheol etherized his body again as if he could not miss it and then kicked and flew in the air. Only the hand returned to reality and held the handle of the devil’s sword. It was a plan of hitting two birds with one stone to disarm me and rearm himself. But this was also what I was aiming for.
I shouted, “Now!”
At that moment…
“Arghhhhh!” Seo Gyu-Cheol fell to the floor. His veins were protruding on his forehead as his body returned to this realm.
“K…. gaaaaaaaaah!”
He rolled on the ground in agony, yet he still held the sword firmly, refusing to let it go. I knew the meaning of that phenomenon.
[Whisper of the Sword!]
As soon as he reached the devil’s sword’s handle, the cognition in it triggered the skill of A-Rank brainwashing. Instead of urging them to agree to the contract as before, it would be smashing his mind with violent telepathy and injecting suggestions repeatedly.
‘It’s similar to Han-Seol’s reaction when exposed to the [Dominating Touch]!’
It seemed that if exposed to another brainwashing as one is in a brainwashed state, an extreme rejection took place. Even if it didn’t last long, it was enough to create this window of opportunity.
“Snake 3!”
I got my hands on the artifact that the snake vomited. One of the SS-Class items that I requested from Ministry Spirit today!
[Dain-Snu Family Slavemaster’s Whip (Rank: SS)]
Item description: The whip of the slave master managed the gladiator slave units owned by the Dain-Snu family. To prevent slaves from striking back with sword energy, an additional function absorbs and consumes the opponent’s Mana. Unfortunately, the absorbed Mana disappears and cannot be stored separately.
As soon as the glossy whip swung, it stretched out and wrapped around Seo Gyu-Cheol’s body.
“Keupp!” The effect of the whip activated as soon as I squeezed him. Weeeing!
The whip began to suck up Seo Gyu-Cheol’s Mana, preventing him from escaping by etherizing himself.
‘Things got easier as the deal with the spirit turned out as I expected!’
I could see the Mana from Seo Gyu-Cheol’s core permeating to the whip. As from the item description, the absorbed blue light soon faded and scattered since the artifact could only evaporate the Mana and neutralize the opponent.
At that moment, I completely removed Mana from Seo Gyu-Cheol’s core.
‘… It’s my first time to see this happening while someone is alive.’
“Gaaah!”
Seo Gyu-Cheol, whose body was tightly bound, and floored, revealed his teeth. I saw his core. Inside the heart, there was not a single Mana left, but there was familiar red energy.
‘It’s the seed!’
I couldn’t guarantee how the results would turn out from then on.
‘Han-Seol and Park Chang-Hee had their seeds destroyed after the host had died.’
But Seo Gyu-Cheol was still alive. What would happen to the host if my seed attacked and killed it? Would it live or die? I decided to experiment with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 76
chapters.content:
Man (1)
An average man would be unconscious by exhaustion, yet Seo Gyu-Cheol was still staring at me with bloodshot eyes.
“You bastard!”
Perhaps because the other host was still alive, the seed in my heart was asleep as if it were dead. I decided to force the seed to wake up, just as I used to do in front of the Iponia. As I was overpowered by [The Successor’s Eye], I had to somehow re-stimulate the dead cell in my core. The Mana waves that occurred when the other seed was destroyed would get recreated inside my body.
‘Geeeek!’
The curse had awakened. The red energy spread out of my heart.
“Now, what do you think? The host’s still alive. Do you want to attack as before?”
Seo Gyu-Cheol couldn’t see the seed in the form of red Mana. He struggled to understand what I said.
“What kind of bullshit are you…!”
Despite this suggestion, the seed in my heart seldom attempted to attack as it had done before.
‘Geeeek?’
It danced around the red tentacles as if it were testing the water. I didn’t see any prominent sensory organs, but I felt like it was looking at the condition. The seed waited as if it were doubting.
‘Geeeeeeeek!’
Suddenly, it stretched out its tentacles, drawing sharp lines. What the end was aiming for was Seo Gyu-Cheol’s seed! It penetrated my body without any resistance or injury; it was no different from pure Mana, having no physical interference. Even if it dugs into Seo Gyu-Cheol’s heart, there would be no physical damage.
“Keup!”
As soon as he encountered my curse, Seo Gyu-Cheol breathed in, and his face hardened. His eyes soon turned upside down, and he became unconscious.
‘Did the Mana exhaustion take place late?’
And then.
‘Geeek!’
‘Geeeek! Geeeeeek!’
The cries of the two kinds of seeds echoed in my mind at the same time. One sounded like that of a greedy predator. The other was like a scream from some creature in agony, as if on the verge of extinction. The seed was attacked while the host was still alive. The red energy that made it up was gradually disappeared.
‘It’s working!’
Seo Gyu-Cheol’s curse was disappearing for sure. I couldn’t shake my bitter feelings as I cheered inwardly. Without the power of Iponia, I could remove the curse with the host alive, but the way for me was to attack it by provoking a curse hidden in my heart. Either way, I couldn’t get rid of my curse.
‘Unless I found a way to force my seed to commit suicide.’
While I was thinking, Seo Gyu-Cheol’s memory, which was stuck in the seed, flowed in at the speed of the light.
‘Is it a copy of the host’s memory? Or will Seo Gyu-Cheol forget all the memories since this is the original version?’
That question didn’t stay in my mind for long as I witnessed the memories of his past flooding my brain.
‘… It’s been this long?’
I was expecting that Seo Gyu-Cheol’s encounter with the source of the curse itself was about 15 years ago. But it wasn’t like that in reality. The event of some being coming to see Seo Gyu-Cheol was a little over 100 days after Seo Jin-Wook was born.
*
Twenty years ago, Seo Gyu-Cheol was holding his head in his mediocre office. He felt like he was pushed into a corner.
‘Was my growth as a hunter… just going to end like this?’
A year earlier, he was an A-Rank hunter in Korea, and his future looked bright. Until the day when his Mana capacity’s growth was over.
‘Was there truly no way to increase the amount of potential Mana?’
Years had passed since the Cataclysm, but the situation was gloomy because no one in the world had found a way to build more Mana or increase consumption efficiency. It was inevitable to rely on very rare items, and the supply was not released in Korea at that time.
‘The Guild Master of the Grand Croix or Destructional Blade was rumored to have reached the potential Mana of S-Rank. If that were true, no matter how slow the activation rate was, an S-Rank hunter would be released in a few years. If the Celestial Dragon fell behind, it was inevitable for the talented to leave.’
The guild was also an issue, but it was bad news even for an individual such as Seo Gyu-Cheol.
‘Was this really to be my end? No matter how good my skills were and how I have increased the masteries…. The difference in combat power that follows Mana seems absolute!’
This was not what Seo Gyu-Cheol always dreamed or what he always desired. For his position as a hunter, it reminded him of a time when he’d reached rock bottom but had managed to stabilize himself and to continue his successful life as a top-notch Awakened. The desire to become a stronger hunter had been driving Seo Gyu-Cheol so far, and despair overwhelmed him when he realized he had reached the end of the road.
‘It can’t end like this. I want to be stronger!’
He was deeply troubled by individuals, family affairs, and even the guild’s internal situation, but this now cast a shadow over his face. It was then that he heard a strange voice.
“Congratulations on your latest son. I heard that your kind say it that way, am I right?” The moment he heard the voice, Seo Gyu-Cheol felt a chill down his spine.
“Who is that?” He quickly raised himself, ready for battle, “You!”
In front of him, a man sat on the armrest of the sofa and looked at him in a relaxed way. He was an ordinary looking man whose face was unremarkable and easily forgotten. He sat in such a way that looked comfortable, almost like he’d been there forever, like some ancient tree that had been rooted deep in the ground for hundreds of years, or even a rock-like inorganic fragment that had been tested by time.
‘No, what am I thinking?’ He shook off his confused thoughts, ‘I didn’t feel any presence at all! When… And how did you get in?!’
His heart thumped erratically. Perhaps he was an Awakened who has mastered a stealth skill. He could only think of one reason to break into the Guild Master’s office this way. Assassination. He clenched his teeth.
“From which guild did they send you?” Seo Gyu-Cheol guessed at the identity of the opponent. Either the Grand Croix or the Destructional Blade. Although the tension had intensified due to the right to Clear, were they that pressured to the point of attempting an assassination? Or was it because his growth as a hunter has been dampened and thought to be eliminated? Otherwise, he could have been hired by a small and medium-sized guild to replace his position by defeating Celestial Dragon. While thinking these things, the man opened his mouth and spoke comfort.
“It’s none of what’s in your head right now.”
“What nonsense!”
“The reason why I found you today is not that you are weaker than them, nor because you are stronger. To get to the point, it’s because of your son.”
At that moment, Seo Gyu-Cheol felt his heart tightening with tension. His wife, a non-Awakened, had died less than a month after giving birth to their first child. The cause of death was a disease diagnosed during pregnancy. Throughout the pregnancy, she suffered, but miraculously, she survived to give birth to their son. But then disaster struck, and she was taken. The pain of losing his wife was terrible, but he never forgot his son.
But the moment the assassin mentioned his son, Seo Gyu-Cheol lost his reason, “How dare you!” Seo Gyu-Cheol pulled out a sword. The blue Mana swayed on the sharp blade. Immediately, he rushed toward the man, leaving a blue trail of sword energy as he struck his blade towards the neck of the man! Seo Gyu-Cheol felt cold sweat dripping down.
‘T-this is?’
As he flung the sword before the man’s neck, an action he’d done so many times, the blade went through the body as if going through a mist. No tissue or bones were cut.
‘Am I possessed by a ghost!’
Seo Gyu-Cheol barely suppressed the shaking of his hand that held the sword. He turned his eyes and looked around. Nothing has changed, but that was the problem. The man sat on the sofa’s armrest, as he did from the moment he first appeared. It was as if nothing had happened.
‘Hallucination?’
However, Seo Gyu-Cheol’s sense of throwing his body was so clearly engraved in his head. Sweat began to pour down his wet back.
“I can’t believe you ran right into me with a sword without care…. You tend to be easily swayed by emotions. Like most humans do. You need a heart transplant. You need to be calm.”
The man gestured lightly towards Seo Gyu-Cheol’s chest. Although there was no tactile sensation felt on the skin, Seo Gyu-Cheol felt as if there was a breeze. Seo Gyu-Cheol’s heart, which had been beating like crazy, gradually regained calmness. The inner self, which had been swirling with anger, fear, shock, and suspicion, cooled down in an instant.
The man spoke in a monotonous tone, “From now on, you won’t be necessarily swayed by your emotions. Except for the circumstances I intend, that is.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol analyzed the situation in his cooled head, but he did feel like a new person.
‘Unidentified skill. Strong enough to penetrate and activate in the short intervals of less than 0.1 seconds.’
After the agitation and intense emotions had died down, it was only then that he realized how dangerous the opponent was.
‘Why did this kind of guy come in here mentioning my son? For a baby who is barely over 100 days old!’
The man looked at him and said, “Yes, it took more than 100 days to narrow the search and find him. I think it’s rather late. But it took that long for your race’s potential to be discerningly embodied. That was an area that I couldn’t touch.”
“Keup….!”
Once again, hot steam rose from the inside of Seo Gyu-Cheol, which seemed to have been frozen just a moment ago.
‘I have to protect him! If he’s here for my son… Even if it costs me my life to kill him here!’
As soon as he had the thought in his head, the man said again. “Ahh, the protective instinct for the offspring that inherited the gene. It is an instinct for mammals that breed for a strangely long time as mortals, continuing their lives through breeding. It also stimulates your feelings unnecessarily. Fatherly love… you don’t need it either while you’re working for me. Let’s put it away from now on.”
The man gestured again. There was a feeling of a wind blowing.
“How do you feel now?”
Seo Gyu-Cheol was immediately aware of the change. Any part that existed inside Seo Gyu-Cheol disappeared as if it were being cut out. He couldn’t understand or empathize with what he was thinking just a second ago. Seo Gyu-Cheol realized that his attachment to his son had been completely erased. But the change did not lead to a sense of loss. He just observes himself calmly.
“Now, shall we get down to business?”
The man’s two corners of his mouth drew a thin curve.
“Let’s define your existence. What is the most important part that makes you, you? Tell me, what is the essential part that you operate in?” His voice’s tone was extremely calm, but Seo Gyu-Cheol somehow felt that the words contained the light of temptation.
“What is your most stimulating desire? Also, what is the most prominent emotion you have?”
Like the mechanical motion of an anatomical sample that touched the nervous system, something came into Seo Gyu-Cheol’s head regardless of his will.
‘I want to be strong—more than anyone else. I don’t want to be pushed back like this. I want to fill a page of history. I want to engrave the name Seo Gyu-Cheol in the world. I want to brag about my achievement and alter ego, the name of Celestial Dragon, next to me!’
The man laughed, “I see. You had a quite simple desire, too. I’ll make it happen.”
As he reached out his hand, Seo Gyu-Cheol felt something sharp and rough flowing into his chest.
“Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!”
He rolled around on the floor of his office, struggling with pain. A few minutes after that…
“Huff… Huf…!”
The pain, like pouring boiling water, stormed his chest and finally stopped. Seo Gyu-Cheol got up as he struggled for breath. Something impossible unfolded before his eyes.
‘Mana…. has increased?’
It was impossible for a hunter, who had exhausted his potential Mana, to activate more than that. An absolute rule that no one has ever doubted, and taken for granted, had been broken. Seo Gyu-Cheol saw his latent Mana, which was definitely “0” a few minutes earlier, increase by precisely 10,000.
– Active Mana: 11,900/13,100
– Potential Mana: 10,000
‘If all of this potential Mana were to be activated ···.’
Seo Gyu-Cheol could become an S-Rank hunter with more than 20,000 active Mana.
The man said promptly, “It’s a gift from me. You don’t have to waste years activating it like ordinary hunters. If you only focus for a day, you will be able to activate all that potential Mana. In just one day.”
If what he said was true, Seo Gyu-Cheol would become the first S-Ranked hunter in South Korea by the next day—making the impossible dream come true. It was an unconscious desire that filled Seo Gyu-Cheol’s heart right after realizing the possibility.
“In return, you’ll have to do something for me from now on. To compare it to your kind’s expression… It’s similar to a gardener’s duty. When the day comes when your labor pays off satisfactorily, I’ll give you a bigger gift than you had today.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol was already kneeling in front of the man. If it were any other day, he would have been suspicious and would try to figure out the other person’s intentions, even if he had just experienced the miracle. However, Seo Gyu-Cheol’s head was filled with euphoria at the fact that a part of his desires had already been achieved, and his desperation to fulfill greater desires remained.
‘More… More from here!’
He felt hunger as if he had a hole in his chest. The urgency of having to fill that hole with something rose and reached the throat.
“In five years, I’ll be back. Then I’d like for your son…. and select two or three additional individuals for your son, to be planted with the seed.”
He couldn’t understand what he meant, but Seo Gyu-Cheol just fell on the floor and listened to the man. His head, already clouded and messy, led him to worship the man.
“Five years… was it?”
On the back of Seo Gyu-Cheol’s head, the man’s calmly uttered words fell, “Yes, they say it takes about five years for your species to develop a basic ego. I’ll be back then. In the meantime, you just have to raise your son ‘greatly.’ The more central the void in the spirit that becomes the soil, the better my seed roots out.”
The man said with a smile, “If it’s you with the cleared and organized mind, I’m sure you’ll be able to raise him well.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol asked, feeling curious, “Then, why bother if you can organize my son’s mind as easily as you did to mine….?”
Sitting on the sofa, he answered Seo Gyu-Cheol’s question, “If your son were just at the level of you, it would be easy, but with a high probability, he wouldn’t be. It doesn’t grow by just planting the seeds, but the ground needs to be cleaned up and fertilized. I borrowed your expressions, but I don’t know if this is the right analogy.”
Whether the analogy was appropriate or not was not crucial to Seo Gyu-Cheol. He was already perfectly reconstructed enough to accept and carry out everything that the man said.
The reason why it was so easy was…the moment he spoke on the sofa, the seed had already penetrated Seo Gyu-Cheol’s heart and deeply eroded his mind. Seo Gyu-Cheol, named the gardener, had no idea that the first seed he had to manage had already settled inside him.
*
And five years later, when Seo Gyu-Cheol was Korea’s first S-Rank hunter, and with the help of Han-Seol, was rapidly expanding the Celestial Dragon Guild, the man came back to see Seo Gyu-Cheol.

chapters.title: Chapter 77
chapters.content:
Man (2)
The man who reappeared in front of Seo Gyu-Cheol had a completely different face and physique five years earlier, but it was still a face easily forgotten. However, as soon as they met, Seo Gyu-Cheol instinctively knew that he was the one he’d met in the office five years ago.
“It’s been a long while since we met.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol lowered his body and paid his respect. No one had told him to, and the man didn’t require him to, but he felt like he should greet him this way. He could hear the man’s voice above his back.
“It’s only been five years, and your descendant is already so marvelous.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol did not know who he was specifically referring to. Whether it was the potential for the Awakened or his talent as an ordinary human being, he was still too young to reveal such things. Instead of expressing doubt, however, Seo Gyu-Cheol waited for his next words. And soon, he found out that what the man was speaking off was a slightly different concept from what he’d thought.
“The heart is a heart, but… I can’t believe that that is the mental strength of a young creature that has only lived for five years. It’s truly firm and superb. I was impressed.”
Mental strength, he said?
Seo Gyu-Cheol replied, bowing his head much lower, “I’m not sure if the soil for the seed to root has been made…”
“You don’t have to worry. You did a great job raising him well. He barely had a gap in his mind. It was a hard rock-like spiritual soil, but the seeds were hard to take root because of the fertilizer called anger.”
He said that due to the method of raising him, which was somewhat closer to emotional abuse by Seo Gyu-Cheol, even his strong spirit, which was challenging to break down, had a crack.
“Have you already been there?”
“Yes, I have planted seeds in two other humans besides your descendant. There were a lot of faces that weren’t seen then. I choose among them.”
In the past five years, Celestial Dragon had achieved tremendous growth on the outside. Seo Gyu-Cheol was convinced, when he heard the names of the two men mentioned, he recognized they were the two strongest people in the guild except himself.
Han-Seol and Park Chang-Hee.
“Both of them are the strongest here.”
“There is a reason for that, but…I chose one because she had a wicked desire, and the other one was also tilted in a strange direction. Anyway, I’ll tell you what you have to do from now on.”
The man’s instructions were simple, but the intention was hard to understand. However, instead of trying to understand, Seo Gyu-Cheol calmly listened.
“My seed will work in a way that amplifies their greatest desire and emotion. You only have to add fuel to the fire and fan it.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol remembered every single word.
“Also, those who have seeds in their hearts are instinctively bound to get involved. In particular, your son will attract other hosts like a flower attracts a bee, so you can help them run more wildly, struggle harder, and pour out more violently.”
The man continued calmly, “If they depend on each other, bind them up tight. If they hate each other, drive them into a small room. Pity, obsession, murderousness, etc.…. let them live on, shooting each other.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol paid attention to one of the words he said. Murderousness? He asked the man, “What if they end up killing each other? Maybe the precious seed might wither away.”
“If it is judged that the blooming takes too late, you can put them in such a situation. What your son has been planted with is a different class of breed from what other hosts have. If he is rather exposed to the danger of death, he will wake up, eat the ones around, and get closer to flowering. But leave that as a last resort. Instead of driving them forcefully, it’s better to let it happen naturally.”
“Okay. Then… I’ll ask you one last question.”
A few months ago, Han-Seol and her hunters joined the group. It was a genuinely exquisite timing for Seo Gyu-Cheol to judge. However, he didn’t expect it to be tailored to the outbreak’s time, predetermined by the [Prophecy]. At this point, Seo Gyu-Cheol was already aware of her unique skill.
“Han-Seol, who you planted the seeds to this time, has the skills to see the future. It is believed that she has not yet seen the future of the seeds being planted in her chest, but if the aftermath of this incident is reflected in the future…”
As Seo Gyu-Cheol also knew, there was a portion that couldn’t be utterly uncontrolled with the [Prophecy]. If she had known that seed would be planted in advance, Han-Seol would not have joined the Celestial Dragon.
‘She doesn’t know yet.’
However, things could go wrong if the content of ‘the man’ or seeds were reflected in the future she would witness. That was what Seo Gyu-Cheol was concerned about. However, the man responded as if it was insignificant.
“Do you think I would look so clumsy to be seen in a prophecy that even the master of the skill has no control over?”
Hearing that, Seo Gyu-Cheol felt chills. The man’s words implied one thing. He was confident that he could control things to prevent his existence or act from being projected into a future scene that Han-Seol would see. It was something beyond his imagination.
“But if she sees my son in the future, wouldn’t she be able to guess?”
“She was able to see it until yesterday.”
His words were true. Han-Seol came to the Celestial Dragon because she saw Seo Jin-Wook’s distant future.
“But it will be impossible from today. I’ve already dug into that heart. Don’t worry; the future that she will see will be limited to trivial things that deviate from the big stem. As soon as she tries harder, her subconscious will feel terror, and she will stop doing so.”
Seo Gyu-Cheol shuddered. ‘This man!’ Seo Gyu-Cheol did not guess about the identity of the man or doubt him. He was only admiring and strengthening his feelings of obedience.
“There are a few more things to note.”
The man consecutively gave additional instructions, such as never to let Seo Jin-Wook enter in a dungeon where the boundary collapsed, or if the seed erosion seemed too slow, there was no need to Awaken him early. He added that the auditory hallucination, like the experience, was evidence that it had not yet been appropriately eroded. The man finished his speech suddenly and knowingly, reading Seo Gyu-Cheol’s mind, “That’s all you have to do. If you do it faithfully, you can look forward to receiving a bigger reward. You don’t mean to stop here, do you?”
Seo Gyu-Cheol realized what he was saying, ‘The potential Mana that he provided then was ten thousand…!’ The activation was finished in an instant. Thanks to him, he became the first S-Rank Hunter in Korea and had been defending the title of the best in Korea, but…
‘It’s the same story that my growth has stopped again!’
He could only grow as much as the man allowed him to. What if he could get the same gift again? No, what if it’s even a bigger gift? It was a cold but deep desire rising from Seo Gyu-Cheol’s heart.
“Well, the next time we’ll see will be after the seed blooms. I’ll let you be until the day of the harvest,” with those words, the man disappeared.
*
Observing the overflowing memory, the shock stiffened my body. Many parts were far from what I expected, and all of these were in the first place…
‘It was a very old plan, targeting the original!’
The man that Seo Gyu-Cheol met twice, no face matched the list of the ministry spirits. He could easily be able to camouflage, seeing that he seemed different every time he appeared.
‘Whatever it was… the alien was only after Seo Jin-Wook!’
It meant that even Seo Gyu-Cheol, Han-Seol, or Park Chang-Hee, who had seeds planted in their hearts, were just tools to develop Seo Jin-Wook’s target as he desired.
There was another reason why I was shocked.
‘The seed eats the other seeds?’
