[Dungeon Key]
Item description: This item is given when having completed a dungeon Clear. Once used for any purpose, it will disappear to prevent reusability.
If you use this key on a Gate, you can close that Gate. If you use this key on a dungeon’s boundaries, you can expand that dungeon’s boundaries. As customary, I handed it over to the expedition leader, and Greg received it without saying a word.
“…”
Much earlier than initially expected, we cleared the S-Class dungeon without any casualties, but no one cheered.
Everyone looked at the three of us with overwhelmed faces.
“…”
After the attack, there was no exchange of praises and greetings that usually took place.
They just cast their eyes at us as if they were possessed.
The silence continued for a while longer, and eventually, I broke the ice because I couldn’t wait.
“Expedition Leader, can I get the extra compensation now, then?”
It didn’t matter if we were scattered, but if we fought in formations like that, it’s common etiquette to let the expedition captain know ahead of time.
The answer came back a tempo late.
“Yeah, huh?! Yeah, R-reward. You should get the… additional compensation.”
Greg nodded with a dazed face.
– Additional rewards are available according to your contribution. Will you accept it?
“I accept.”
As soon as I delivered my will to the system, the darkness surrounded me.
There was a flash like a group of stars in the night sky.
– Please select a reward.
I focused my attention on the choices one by one.
The unique Mana patterns were hidden behind them and never overlapped.
Looking at each of the dancing patterns in the light, I guessed what item or skill it would be.
And most importantly, the rank as well.
‘There it is!’
After observing, I found the target I wanted.
‘SSS-Class!’
There was only one top-rated item that could come out of the S-Rank dungeon.
‘I was a little nervous because my contribution was barely over 50%.’
If the contribution was low, it might not appear in the option at all.
‘Looking at the pattern, it’s armor. All right.’
I talked to the system.
“I choose that one!”
The luminescence object I designated came close and circled around.
Immediately after that, its brilliance scattered.
And the item that appeared was very familiar to me.
‘Huh? No way…’
*
After receiving the item, I returned to the dungeon.
The scenery changed, and everyone’s gaze could be felt again.
As expected, Hibiki and Nate, who were eligible for additional compensation, returned first. Reading the artifact patterns in their arms, what they got were mediocre rewards. They would have picked whatever they could. There’s no way for them to tell the difference.
‘What a shame. Unfortunately, I can’t come with them.’
“Hmm, hmm.”
Greg, the exploration leader, opened his mouth as he put the dungeon key into his backpack.
It’s a bit awkward.
“… Everyone did a great job. Now let’s head back.”
Since they hadn’t seen any additional compensation, it’s reasonable for voices of dissatisfaction to be raised, but no one made it obvious.
That meant that it was an overwhelming performance that made all of them reluctant to speak up afterward.
‘Huh?’
While everyone was preparing to go back after maintenance, a hunter, who was dispatched from Japan, quietly approached Hibiki.
Hibiki, who rarely showed her expression, made a blatantly dreadful expression.
‘Her purpose is obvious.’
I was about to go to her and drive her away, but then I stopped.
Looking at the timing, it’ll soon…
‘It’s almost time.’
If I wanted to proceed as I planned, I shouldn’t go back to the Gate and close the door.
While I was thinking of that-
‘…!’
The whisper of a strange being penetrated my mind.
– Awakened, can you hear me?
“Hmm!”
The telepathy wasn’t just delivered to me.
The bodies of the explorers, who lowered their guard and were preparing to return, stiffened again.
Many of them instinctively picked up their weapons.
“Is this a system message?”
Naturally, they misunderstood it. Most of them must have never been exposed to that type of telepathy.
It wasn’t the system, but a mental wave delivered by another Awakened.
The origin was over the weakened dungeon boundary after the Clear.
It flowed from a dungeon connected to another dimension’s Gate.
“Did anyone else hear that? No, I don’t have to ask based on the looks on your faces.”
The captain of the expedition bit his lips as if it’s a bad situation.
He was baffled in the face of a phenomenon he had never experienced.
Meanwhile, the telepathic message continued.
– Take it easy. I haven’t stepped into your dungeon yet. I’m in another dungeon that borders that dungeon. Thanks to the weakening of the wall between the two dungeons after having finished the Clear, I was able to deliver telepathic messages.
Someone murmured.
“Aliens?”
They realized that the opponent wasn’t a system but a species of another world.
“Is this the same situation as the cockroach alien from the New York Gate? Wasn’t that incredibly dangerous?”
The fact that the opponent’s response was so fast meant that they were waiting in front of the dungeon boundary for us to finish the Clear.
The commotion was getting louder.
Based on the people of that era’s experience, encountering aliens within dungeons had never turned out well.
“I mean, they did say that they haven’t crossed over to our dungeon yet.”
“How can we believe that?”
As if they had guessed the conversation that was being exchanged, the alien continued to send out psychological waves.
– Don’t worry. Without your consultation and confirmation regarding our entry, we will not cross the dungeon boundary one-sidedly, nor will we force our way into your dimension. The reason why I contacted you today is in hopes of reviewing the relative advantage of resources in both worlds and creating trading opportunities.
I clapped inside.
‘Yeah, this is it! This is how cultured species greet each other.’
They were extremely different from ignorant and primitive beings that penetrated and invaded worlds as soon as the boundaries were weakened, like the Ersmanns and Botarchs.
Instead of just stepping on other people’s land right away, they politely knocked outside the door and asked for their willingness to communicate.
‘It’s been a while since I’ve seen sensical beings. It was driving me mad.’
In my past life, we didn’t meet their race until a few years later, but I moved the time forward.
In my previous life, the dungeon used as a passage didn’t even exist.
It was common to have more than one passageway, just as there were two countries, the United States and South Korea, connected to the Ersmann dimension.
“Hmm.”
Greg frowned as he focused on telepathy.
In an invisible place for us, the species continued to explain for a few minutes, politely informing us that they wanted to make a deal with Earth.
– So, what do you think about our suggestion?
“…”
– I would be able to hear and understand if you answer by voice.
In that case, it was only proper for the exploration team leader to take the lead.
Supposedly, that should’ve been the case.
But…
“Hey, I’m sorry, but I don’t have the authority to decide that! And our Gate is ‘very unstable.’ My instructions are to take the dungeon key and close this door.”
– Oh. Is that so? I’m sorry to hear that.
Greg, who was uptight, seemed to be really determined to close the Gate.
I couldn’t let that happen.
– If that’s the case, we can’t push it too hard.
The alien responded with a mental wave as if they understood.
‘That reaction means that they’re ignoring us! They already tested our waters.’
There was no longer any need to think about whether people on Earth were on par with them in terms of business and objectives.
Greg’s answer just then became the clear evidence to conclude so.
“Wait a minute!”
Greg’s expression hardened when I suddenly stepped in.
“Hey!”
Was he trying to prove that since he had already been crushed in terms of contributions in the dungeon raid, he wouldn’t allow anyone to violate his command any further? Regardless, I didn’t pay any attention to him.
I quickly spoke with the aliens that I believed were still listening to my voice, completely ignoring his reaction.
“That’s right, this dungeon and our dimensionally connected Gate are in a ‘very unstable’ state. Hence, if you want to make a deal, can you provide us with an Aurora of Stability? We will need it to restore the dungeon state to a ‘slightly unstable’ or ‘normal’ state. That would allow us to keep the Gate open instead of fulfilling our objective of closing it.”
Then a sigh broke out among the hunters.
The item information that covered Korea’s sky had already been identified by every single region through the [Analysis] skill. Even if I uttered its name in front of others, it wouldn’t cause me any problems at all.
– …
The alien delivered an answer after a brief silence.
– Of course. I almost acted rudely.
They accepted my proposal.
In the head of the opponent, who I hadn’t yet seen its face, I could expect the evaluation of us to rise again.
‘Yes, that’s the etiquette of doing business between dimensions. First, the person who proposed the deal first hands an Aurora of Stability so that we can keep the Gate open to be utilized as a tunnel.’
When it heard Greg’s reply, the alien thought we were a race that didn’t even know such things. That led them to the decision of trying to cut us off.
The alien asked through telepathy.
– By any chance, may I ask your name?
“I’m Seo Jin-Wook.”
– My name is ‘Egrasto.’ I’d like to continue discussing with Mr. Seo Jin-Wook. Is that possible?
Greg’s face became even more distorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 112
chapters.content:
The First Deal (4)
I looked at the hunters with a glance that seemed to say, ‘What are you going to do about it?’
I then shrugged my shoulders as if to say, ‘Now that it’s like this, you can’t do anything about it, right?’
“Wait a minute!”
It was, of course, Greg who argued at that point.
“The only authority the governments have entrusted to us is to Clear the dungeons and receive compensation. Not to mention, I’m the one in charge of this expedition!”
Jeez, that stuck-up human.
I was starting to feel annoyed.
“Well, what are you planning to do?”
It was the other hunters who participated in the Clear that stopped him.
The first one to speak out was a hunter from Italy.
There were quite a few Gates in the ‘very unstable’ state, causing the Aurora of Stability to become desirable.
I remembered that he approached me and was desperate to steal information when we were camping yesterday.
He questioned Greg with a puzzled look on his face.
“Yes, you’re the expedition leader. I won’t deny it. But your command is limited to the dungeon Clear! That’s also putting aside your questionable contribution to it.”
When he pointed out that Greg’s command was virtually meaningless, Greg had his veins protruding around his neck, and his nostrils flared.
“Hey, are you suggesting a fight?!”
The hunter of Italy didn’t even pretend to hear it but continued what he wanted to say.
“And even if you are the expedition leader, you have no authority to trash the opportunity for humankind to interact with civilized aliens for the first time!”
“…!”
“Didn’t you hear that? They said they would give us the Aurora of Stability! If they could give us one, why would two of them be impossible? Don’t you think it’s an opportunity to place them in the skies around the world like Korea?”
I murmured internally.
‘Wrong, you got it wrong.’
There were strict restrictions on the export of that item in most worlds, and the limit for starting a deal was only one.
The same went for the species we had come into contact with.
‘It can’t be a trade item in the first place, but they at least allow for the practical reason that it’s necessary to keep the door open.’
However, I remained silent as I observed them. It wasn’t necessary to mention that knowledge.
“I agree as well!”
“Me too! Why do we have to flip the negotiating table when they’re acting favorably?”
Hunters from around the world had all opposed Greg’s opinion.
Everyone was in a hurry because of the Aurora of Stability, which was an unprecedented concern. With the Korean government and I keeping our mouths shut, they desired the item that they couldn’t even get a clue about.
And even if they wouldn’t be the one acquiring it, it seemed like they didn’t want to miss the first historical moment of dealing with aliens.
They seemed to be looking forward to a rake-off just in case.
Greg’s face turned redder as he heard the pouring criticism.
“… Damn it!”
He spat and then made a final counterargument.
“Wait, everyone’s being so complacent right now. Cool your head down and think about it. How can we trust those aliens?”
“What?”
“Isn’t this too coincidental? The timing suggests they waited outside the perimeter of the dungeon for us to clear it. And so did the cockroaches in New York!”
The aliens outside the boundaries, Egrasto, must be able to hear and understand our conversation. However, they remained silent about it.
I knew the reason behind it.
‘They wish to unify the communication channel with the Earth into one person, which was me. They don’t want to talk to several people in unison since that would only cause more headaches.’
I threw my voice toward the boundary.
“Egrasto, before we move forward, there seems to be something that we have to clarify.”
– Yes, please go ahead.
As expected, even though we hadn’t given a definite answer, that alien was already responding to only my words.
Everyone’s eyes were on me again, and I asked the alien, ignoring the rays the people shot at me from their eyes.
“Does your kind stand by all the dungeon boundaries this way? I want to ask the reason why you chose our dimension and waited. It wouldn’t have been a coincidence. The beings we have experience with are those who wanted to invade, regardless of the opponents.”
– That’s a reasonable question. We don’t try to make deals with all the Gates and the worlds connected to our dimension. In this case, our Pezra species knew about your dimension in advance.
“How so?”
I asked even though I knew the answer.
I wanted all the other hunters can hear about it.
Egrasto started to explain.
– You are aware of the species called the Botarchs, right?
“…?”
Question marks came upon the faces of the Awakened except for me.
– This is how they look like.
In our heads, the image that the other being sent popped up.
“… Cow?”
It only looked like a cow head to other Earthlings’ eyes, but they’re aliens familiar to my eyes.
– They are a barbaric race that lives in a third world, not on Earth, not on our own. It’s a species that belong among those that ‘tries to invade regardless of the opponent.’
“…”
– They used to come into Pezra’s dimension without knowing their place, but they were taught a lesson and ran away, and they were nowhere to be seen. And not long ago, they invaded our dimension again. There weren’t many, so I took them as captives and questioned them.
In the first place, the Botarchs weren’t at the level to challenge that species.
Nevertheless, the High Priest seemed to have followed my instructions faithfully.
– But they were equipped with these.
Another image appeared in my head.
I saw the Botarch upper-class’s favorite accessories made out of molten iron taken from Earth.
– It’s a mineral that doesn’t exist in our dimension. We haven’t seen it in Botarch’s past invasions as well. Therefore, it attracted a lot of Pezra’s attention, making us interrogate the prisoners.
They continued explaining what I had already finished observing through the [Door of Hope].
– It turns out, the source was… your kind’s dimension.
“…?!”
At those words, everyone once again made a confused expression.
They seemed to be asking how those never-before-seen cow heads took the Earth’s resources.
– We’ve heard that the Botarchs have given up their invasion and have retreated because of your dimension’s excellent response. Those ornaments were made of minerals that had been plundered before.
There was a growing commotion among hunters who didn’t understand the situation. ‘Botarch? Have you heard of it?’ ‘No, not at all.’ ‘Which country was invaded? And they fought, won, and even kicked them out?’
Thanks to the Chinese government’s complete control of information, hunters from other countries had never heard of it.
There were no Chinese there. Hence, only I knew of them among the party.
– That’s how we discovered your world, which is connected to the Botarch dimension. We looked for a passage so we wouldn’t have to go through one more dimension but rather would directly connect to Pezra. We have been waiting by dispatching a number of us to all the dungeons that meet the conditions. We thought it would be a good dealing opportunity.
Just by listening up to that point, anyone could grasp how advanced Pezra’s civilization was.
They had mastered the concept of dimensional coordinates and dimensional mapping that people on Earth couldn’t even fathom yet.
Of course, it would be only connected-to-the-neighborhood level, which was a limited area compared to the coordinates I saw and remembered.
“You’re saying that you need that mineral enough to take that much trouble?”
– Yes, we don’t know the name since it’s a nonexistent element in our world, but…
Shortly afterward, hunters seemed to understand the telepathic description of their appearance and character.
Someone muttered.
“That thing, doesn’t it look like iron?”
That mineral was common on earth.
The hunter from Italy couldn’t stand it and shouted over the boundary.
“If we provide that mineral, can we exchange it for the Aurora of Stability?”
– …
Egrasto didn’t reply.
The hunter then gave me a desperate look.
After nodding, I asked a question that I already knew the answer to.
– I’m sorry, that isn’t possible.
It explained that only one of that item could be provided in return for the transaction’s commencement.
– The Aurora of Stability cannot be an official trade item, but don’t be disappointed. Here are the special products that are our pride. These are well-received products in most worlds that we made a trade partnership with.
Right after that, a large amount of information flowed into our heads at the speed of light.
“Gasp!”
The hunters who were new to that kind of communication were unable to adapt easily, causing them to struggle.
Some of them stumbled momentarily.
‘Even for A-Rank and S-Rank Awakened, this kind of telepathy is just like a psychological attack.’
Nate also grabbed his head as he must have felt a headache.
‘The rather unaffected ones would be… Only Hibiki?’
She seemed to have split her consciousness with [Multiple Cognition] in no time and was processing that enormous information.
Massive data flowed at the speed of thought.
‘Without me, trade couldn’t have started in the first place, but even if they had been lucky enough to pass the first hurdle, they would have been stuck here again.’
I nodded my head, calmly checking the information flooding into my mind.
I then told the other confused Awakened to share the information we had heard so far with each country’s governments.
The hunters agreed, but Greg, who was completely deprived of his leadership, made a displeased expression.
Everyone then gave me a strange look.
Looking at the flow, they realized that all countries would have to pass through me in order to make a deal with those aliens in the future.
“I don’t know how many items on the list we would need… But it seems like if we want to make a deal in the future, we will need to go to Seo Jin-Wook first.”
Someone murmured like that as if they were despondent.
– Then, I will see you again, Mr. Seo Jin-Wook.
Egrasto and I decided on the time to meet again in the same location.
– I hope I can talk to you again next time.
After greeting me, Egrasto’s presence disappeared.
Meanwhile, there was another disturbance between the remaining hunters.
“W-wait. Everyone, did you understand? Can you remember all of it?”
That was because they failed to properly interpret the contents of the large-scale mental waves Egrasto delivered.
That was more about experience and know-how than natural memory or mental ability. Anyone could keep it in their head for a while if they properly understood the meaning when the opponent sent it. However, everyone missed the timing and leaked almost all of it out of their minds.
‘It must have been on purpose.’
It was Egrasto’s last test.
Thanks to it, even if everyone wanted to deliver it to their guild and government, they wouldn’t be able to deliver even half of the list that the alien provided.
I looked at the people whose faces were cast with shadows.
‘Everyone, in the end, will look for me.’
*
While returning to the private jet prepared by the Australian government, Hibiki asked me something curiously.
“Will the governments of each country agree to the offer?”
According to my past memory, they would.
“I think so. Their response will be quick.”
They didn’t know when the Gate would collapse, so they had no choice but to hasten their actions.
The Aurora of Stability would only be handed over upon the confirmation of the first deal.
After returning to Earth, Greg reported what had happened in the dungeon to the Australian government and, of course, the government ordered not to close the Gate.
About 50 hunters who contributed to the attack witnessed something on the field, and it would have been burdensome to ignore it and push through.
They wouldn’t have wanted to give up the advantage of opening a ‘marketplace’ within their own territory where they could trade with aliens for the first time in human history.
“I think Jin-Wook is in a losing trade.”
Nate butted in the conversation.
“Aren’t you going to be super busy from now on? That alien said he would only talk to Jin-Wook from now on. Gosh, I’d be so annoyed.”
“In return, I’m earning something as well.”
In the past life, when Angelica said a word, governments around the world eventually followed her opinion. It was thanks to the authority that the prophecy held and the skill that manipulated their minds.
I had to control the game so that my voice would weigh that much.
It was needed to create a future exactly opposite to the destruction of humankind that Angelica intended.
“Oh yeah, what did you receive, Jin-Wook?”
Nate asked while fiddling with the A-Class skill card that he received as a reward.
“Ah, the reward.”
I recalled the event that happened right after the Clear.
*
Woong!
In the space where additional rewards were received, white light painted the surroundings like explosions.
The item that appeared was familiar to my eyes.
“…!”
There was a small, transparent glass tube.
Inside the see-through interior, calm light particles sparkled brightly.
When I touched it, a system message appeared.
[Mass-produced Energy Suit: Imperial Combat Officer Type (Rank: SSS)]
Item Description: An armor that was supplied to an Imperial officer in the Sebrarian Imperial Army. Among them, it was distributed to combat officers at the front line, boasting the highest protection capability among personal armor at the time when the empire existed.
This item does not work using cores. Rather, it will only be activated when the user injects the Mana himself. Five Mana per second is required for minimal maintenance after activation, and the amount of Mana consumption may increase depending on the impact imposed.
‘No wonder it looked like the [Stardust Wing]. It’s a Sebrarian again?’
I read the item description again.
‘Say, it consumes 5 Mana per second?’
I looked at my current status.
– Active Mana: 175,000 (+73,900)/101,100
– Latent Mana: 186,000
‘If I just set it on active and did nothing, it wouldn’t last half a day.’
It wasn’t as useful to people with ordinary Mana capacity.
‘How big was the Mana capacity of the Imperial officers to use these items?’
Without having to think about it, I decided to use it.
Since I had already experienced it during that time I got the [Stardust Wing], the equipment method was predictable.
I placed the clear vial on my arm.
Wee-ing!
A small needle protruded from the tip of the glass vial.
A light hologram arrow was projected from the needle, pointing to the veins in the forearm.
The moment I pierced it into the place it was pointing towards, my body quickly absorbed the powder of light inside it.
And like the moment when I first got the wings, I felt the warm energy storming in my body, but it soon calmed down.
‘Shall I test it out?’
I delivered my intention to the transplanted item in my body.
Woong!
A faint light surrounded my body.
Misty substances subtly wrapped around my skin and over the combat suit.
‘This is an item that boasts the highest level of protective capability back in the Imperial world?’
As a result, there were a total of six imperial heritages in my hands.
First of all, there were three that I chose myself when I received the additional compensation.
[Door of Hope (Rank: SSS)]
[Mass-produced Energy Suit: Imperial Combat Officer Type (Rank: SSS)]
[Stardust Wing (Rank: SS)]
And three things I got from the ministry spirit due to the deal.
[Wartime Emergency Production Supply System – Type 3 (Rank: SS)]
[The 3rd Class Imperial Guard Program (Rank: SS)]
[The Flute of the Imperial Palace Artist (Rank: SS)]
At that point, it made me think that it’s strange.
‘Doesn’t it fit too right to consider it as a coincidence?’
The ministry spirit gave it to me because I requested it, but I couldn’t help but question it since it came out that way even when I was choosing it by random.
The common feature of items with the keyword ‘Sebrarian Empire’ was that they were unheard of in my previous life.
Another thing in common was that they had great abilities. It was all proven except for the [The Flute of the Imperial Palace Artist] stuck in the snake inventory because I couldn’t figure out how to use it.
‘These good items were never known in my previous life.’
It meant that they were items with a slim chance of discovery…
‘No matter how much I distinguished it with [The Successor’s Eyes], does it make sense that such precious items come out so much? Only to me?’
There were also many SS-Rank and SSS-Rank items without the keywords of ‘Imperial”, but I had rarely chosen such items.
Whenever I picked, it’s a heritage.
I strongly felt that I was past the stage to let it pass as just being lucky.
‘This… There’s something strange about it.’

chapters.title: Chapter 113
chapters.content:
The First Deal (5)
A few days after returning home, I was having a meeting at the Blue House.
The participants were the president, the foreign affairs minister, the Hunter Management minister, and me. Only those four people.
It was a secret meeting that was made completely unknown to the public.
“At a ministerial meeting where representatives from each country gathered, Korea’s stake was finalized at 75 percent.”
Listening to the foreign affairs minister, I nodded my head.
He was referring to the meeting held by representatives of governments from 12 countries who participated in Australia’s last dungeon expedition.
They decided to keep the fact that they had contact with aliens in the dungeon as a secret for the time being. They were careful not to leak the news to countries that didn’t send explorers, as well as the press. That was because they were concerned about possible accidental scenarios. The official announcement was scheduled after the first deal was safely and properly completed.
Therefore, the expedition team hunters kept their mouths shut, and the government officials from the 12 countries contacted each other secretly to coordinate the details.
“75% is a little over 2,000 tons.”
Egrasto expressed his desire to buy 3,000 tons of steel in his first deal.
When considering the global daily trade volume, it was easy to prepare such supplies. It was of a scale that any country could prepare alone.
‘It would have been too much to push for all 3,000 tons to be supplied from Korea.’
The desire of each government would be the same. If possible, supply all 3,000 tons of goods from their own country and monopolize the trade products it would receive in return.
Considering the Celestial Dragon Guild’s performance in the dungeon, South Korea deserved to demand that much. Still, in the end, it seemed that they agreed at around 75% in consideration of the relationship with other countries.
The remaining 25% was shared among the remaining 11 countries.
Knowing the deal itself would be impossible if I didn’t come forward, they also agreed that Korea would take up that much volume.
‘The whole world needs to be ready to prepare for the main quest anyway. There’s no point in Korea’s monopoly. They can share that much.’
Instead, it was necessary to take the most efficient method.
“Then… As the Guild Master advised, the commodities that our government will demand in exchange will be all in the form of metal called ‘Admanterium.'”
The list that Egrasto showed as a mental wave was a mixture of items that would benefit humankind and things that would not. There was no prior information about us, so they prepared every type because they didn’t know what we would like. They focused on popular products as well.
Among them, what I selected and advised to be traded with was Admanterium.
“And as we promised with you, Guild Master, we will transfer the entire volume to the new JD Corp. lab in Korea.”
“Yes, thank you.”
JD Corp. wais the name of a J/V company jointly invested in by Celestial Dragon and Danton Corporation. It’s made by taking my name and the Senator’s initials.
The president raised a question with anticipating eyes.
“The substance is a catalyst for stabilizing the Mana core, you said?”
“According to my interpretation of telepathy, yes.”
Although actually, it’s something I had known from before.
“It’s said to be a material that can dramatically increase the energy production efficiency of Mana core. Well, I’m sure our researchers will need to take a closer look at it for more information.”
Mana cores contained enormous energy compared to density and would explode when pressure and heat were applied to them above a certain level. Using its properties, I wiped out the Ersmanns in the dungeon before, and some of the weapons used by hunters were bombs made of cores.
However, under particular pressure, cores would emit long periods of high heat instead of exploding. Power plants produced electricity from that heat energy. Thanks to that, cores had replaced fossil fuels and nuclear power entirely. That was because there was no emission of hazardous substances in the power generation process, and the efficiency was overwhelmingly superior.
That superior power generation efficiency could be further increased by several times using Admanterium.
The material was also an essential key to upgrading the quality of mass-produced artifacts.
“That would be the biggest revolution since the Cataclysm.”
The president’s face was filled with a bright smile.
“I don’t know how to thank you, Guild Master. You’ve done something massive for your country once again.”
“I’m flattered. I’m concerned that our researchers will have to make an achievement as soon as possible.”
Of course, they would finish research and experiment irrationally quickly and figure out how to apply that new material to the current construction methods.
Through my help, that was.
“By the way, can you meet the deadline?”
I couldn’t do everything, including the collection of steel, so I had left that to the government.
The Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade nodded with a confident look.
“Don’t worry about it.”
*
When foreign countries heard our decision, they also showed a tendency to concentrate on Admanterium. They were sure my advice would have influenced that decision, and they were convinced that we didn’t choose it for no reason.
Although their country’s hunters couldn’t pick it up properly, they seemed to believe that I would be different.
Meanwhile, what the Pezra species demanded was not iron ore but processed steel, and they were airlifted from Indonesia because there were no steel mills in Australia.
It was common sense for raw iron materials to be transported by sea due to their weight, but governments had mobilized dozens of transport planes to meet the delivery date. It was said that it would be the first time in human history that such a large amount of steel would be transported by aircraft.
“How come it’s getting hotter?”
On the day when both sides agreed to exchange goods, hunters worldwide entered the Australian Gate and headed for the dungeon boundary, each with a roll of steel coils.
Dozens of tons of weight was a piece of cake for hunters of A-Rank or higher, but the reason why most hunters were soaked in sweat right at that moment was because of the temperature.
The temperature was soaring enough even for their bodies to react. The closer they approached the boundary, the more prevalent it was.
“[Heat Resistance (Rank: SSS)]”
When Hibiki, who was walking with a bunch of coils floating using psychokinesis, quietly cast a spell…
“Oh, it’s definitely better.”
“Thanks!”
Appreciation poured out from all over the place. The wizards must’ve guessed the identity of the spell, so they made an expression that seemed to say: ‘Indeed…’ They must have been convinced that it was an SSS-Class spell after experiencing the effects.
“There it is to meet us.”
In front of us was the boundary of a dungeon that obscurely distorted the color and shape of a being.
Beyond that, dozens of aliens could be seen in a blurry manner.
“So, that’s what they look like. But I think the heat is coming from beyond.”
Someone got it right.
It was so hot because of the body temperature emitted by the aliens gathered there.
“It’s not clear, but they look strange even at first glance.”
“Hey, didn’t flame just come out of their nostrils?”
The Pezra were not carbon but silicon-based creatures.
In their body, molten metal flowed instead of body fluids. Their bones, organs, and muscles were composed of hard alloys.
– You’d better stop there. Our body temperature may be too much for humans.
A familiar mental wave flowed out. It was Egrasto.
– Mr. Seo Jin-Wook, long time no see. I have prepared the trade items you mentioned in advance. At the same time, we should push it across the boundary.
Upon receiving the signal, Hibiki was handed a steel coil from all the rest of the expedition team members and pushed it straight toward the weakened boundary. Although it was for a short time, everyone’s faces were shocked to see her handling thousands of tons of weight.
– Here it is.
The other side also sent the Aurora of Stability and the promised quantity of goods toward our dungeon.
As the two sides’ products intersected…
Egrasto spoke.
– Thank you. I hope we can maintain a stable trade alliance between the two dimensions.
As soon as the meaning he emanated permeated.
Paht!
A system message appeared in front of me.
– QUESTION COMPLETE!
– Quest Name: First Regiment
– Description: Contribute to the establishment of alliances in conjunction with other dimensions in the tutorial’s progress.
– Rewards: 500,000 Experience Points have been awarded to the user!
‘Wow!’
I was internally amazed.
The lowest reward for that quest was 100,000. The amount was five times that point.
– Thank you again for the successful transaction.
Egrasto greeted me.
– After the clinical trial, we will have a chance to buy more. I look forward to your kind cooperation.
A hunter murmured in wonder.
“… They’re going to perform a clinical trial with lumps of iron?”
It was a natural question since they didn’t know that they purchase iron for medical purposes, such as dissolving it, mixing it with other substances, and injecting it into the body.
Dissolved steel functioned as medicine to them.
‘This isn’t the end. Now the linked quests I have are…’
As soon as I thought about it, the message comes to mind.
– Quest Name: First Regiment (2) – Learn from those who have gone further first.
– Description: The Pezra are believed to have already carried out significant progress on tutorial quests. Hear from them a clue as to how to end the tutorial.
– Reward: 100,000 experience points.
The contents were more detailed according to the current situation.
The meaning of ‘gone further first’ was evident.
‘Pezra has already summoned the Tower of Choice and is in the progress of Clearing it.’
The system was telling us to get information from them and attempt the same thing at our dimension.
If I didn’t know anything about the Tower of Choice, the quest would’ve been meaningful as well.
But…
‘I already knew that, and I’ve talked to Adam about this keyword. Still, such quests are triggered just like in the past life.’
It was as expected.
‘I guess the system can’t track my memories or my every movement. It just carries on the process mechanically like a pre-populated program.’
– … Hmm.
Meanwhile, Egrasto, beyond the boundary, turned its gaze towards the air as if it had found something.
It was a gesture that it’s reading the system’s messages.
A quest must have also been delivered to him simultaneously since Egrasto was also a chosen Awakened in that world.
I took the lead.
– From now on, let’s talk in this way.
I sent a mental wave to Egrasto.
It was in the form of whisper-like telepathy that focused on only one person so that it wasn’t delivered to others.
Then, the alien responded in the same way.
– All right. Our screening quest list has just been updated. I think the same thing happened to Mr. Seo Jin-Wook’s world’s quest list.
I replied.
– That’s right. It says to ask your kind, the Pezra species, about the method of ending the tutorial.
– What came up on our list was to teach your species that. It’s great luck that I met you. The transaction was carried out neatly, but I also earned experience points with these simple quests.
The system gave quests to both races with clear intent.
He continued his words with a sense of satisfaction.
– The method is simple. In order to finish the tutorial, you need to clear the structure called ‘Top of Choice.’
After that, it was an explanation that I knew all about, but I listened without interrupting.
While the conversation continued instantly at the speed of thought, other hunters did not notice any signs.
Then-
– QUESTION COMPLETE!
– Rewards: 100,000 Experience Points have been awarded to the user!
Since it was a simple quest like an event, the reward was small, and of course, had no bonus.
And…
Paht!
‘Okay, it’s finally up.’
– Quest Name: Verification of Qualification (1)
– Description: To climb the Tower of Choice, you must prove your qualification as a worthy Awakened. Successfully Clear an SS-Class dungeon in your world and secure more than 20% of the contribution rate.
– Rewards: from 1 million experience points based on contribution.
– This quest can also be shared with non-chosen.
It was the quest I was waiting for.
*
“Attack you, Jin- Wook?”
“Yeah, do it with maximum possible firepower.”
After handing over all of Korea’s secured supplies to J/V from sharing the traded prize received from the Pezra species according to each country’s shares, I headed for the dungeon.
The purpose was to test the effects of the item.
Woong!
[Mass-produced Energy Suit: Imperial Combat Officer Type (Rank: SSS)]
That kind of dungeon was perfect for work that the training room in the house’s basement couldn’t handle.
When I activated the item, a shallow light surrounded my body.
Nate looked at me with worried eyes.
“You’re not… gonna die, are you?”
Hibiki muttered in a way that seemed to say he was worrying about a meaningless thing.
“It’s better to worry about the Earth being doomed before that.”
From her perspective, it must have been a joke, but it was a below-the-belt remark for me.
Nate continued with a grim look.
“If Jin-Wook dies, I’ll miss you, so I’ll turn you into my subordinate…”
“I refuse. And don’t worry. I won’t die.”
“Then… All right.”
Swish!
When Nate gestured, a giant shadow overcast all of us.
The giant undead dragon covered the sky.
“Should we start with Breath from the beginning?”
“Yeah. Even if the item can’t stand it, I have a plan, so don’t worry and shoot.”
“Alright.”
After receiving confirmation, Nate gave the dragon an order.
Kwaaaaaa!
The explosive flames spewed out by the undead dragon swept around me.
Boosh!
After the hot air that burned the air and the currents of the flame swept through the earth…
I murmured with admiration.
“Oh, that’s really useful.”
Nate swept away his sweat as he saw me standing still without a single burn.
Hibiki, who didn’t seem to be worried in the first place, stared at me with a calm look.
‘I thought it would consume some Mana if I blocked this attack of this intensity with a normal barrier… This method is much more efficient.’
Of course, it was true that the amount of consumption couldn’t be handled by the general Awakened’s Mana capacity because the blocked damage was quite a lot.
But it’s much more efficient than pouring it in raw.
[Inferno (Rank: SSS)]!
[Greater Force Wave (Rank: SSS)]!
[Chain Lightning Buster (Rank: SSS)]!
Hibiki also fired SSS-Rank magic of various properties, but my body’s shield kept me safe without a shake.
“Now, then.”
I did the last experiment myself.
Woong!
I swung the devil’s sword a few times in the air after injecting Mana into it.
After keeping Hibiki and Nate far away, I instilled a pulling force in the purple afterimage in the air.
As I did that…
Shhh!
Boo-boom!
A storm of sword energy drove toward me, and the air exploded with a roar.
The intense energy exploded in the short distance.
But then.
“… Huh.”
Nate looked at me with a dazed face.
Again that time, the defense remained perfect.
“Okay, that’s handy!”
While I mumbled satisfactorily-
‘… By this, you became an even more awful monster.’
The devil’s sword grumbled as if it didn’t like what was going on.

chapters.title: Chapter 114
chapters.content:
A Dangerous Invitation (1)
When I came out of the dungeon, I saw a missed call notification.
Calls couldn’t be received in environments where external transmission was blocked.
‘It’s the Senator.’
It seemed quite urgent, considering he left three phone calls in such a short period. I told Nate and Hibiki to wait for a while before calling him. As if he was waiting eagerly for me, his hologram appeared quickly.
“Were you roaming around dungeons?”
“Yes. Our timing must’ve been off.”
The Senator looked like he was displeased about something.
“Is there any problem?”
Instead of answering me right away, he turned his gaze to the people behind me. He must’ve been able to see Nate and Hibiki from his perspective.
“It’s alright. You don’t have to worry about them. They’re my most trusted colleagues.”
“If you say so.”
Only then did he talk about the issue.
“The American government has noticed us.”
“The embargo will commence at 3:00 tomorrow based on Korea’s timezone, and it’s later than I thought. They only learned about it a day before the official announcement would be released.”
Twelve countries, including South Korea, had completed the first deal with the aliens and were set to announce to the press that they had acquired a catalyst that didn’t exist on Earth.
“The White House contacted me today, so they must have identified what the 12 countries did yesterday, part of which was excluding the U.S.”
The U.S. and China, the world’s two most significant powers, didn’t send hunters to the Australian dungeon exploration, causing them to be left out of the deal.
However, it seemed that the situation had already been analyzed through their information channel before the official announcement revealed it.
The U.S. government then summoned the Senator and talked to him since he managed the joint investment with Celestial Dragon to run the J/V.
“Did they show their temper?”
“They looked like Earth is about to explode. They think it doesn’t make sense for the United States to miss such an important historical moment. Rather than being one of the usual key players, they’re treated as an old man in the back room.”
“I didn’t expect them to react to that extent.”
“I’m sure you already know that the people over there always want to control every major event in the world.”
He continued.
“That’s why you should have dispatched the U.S. as I suggested earlier!”
The U.S. didn’t send any hunters because of their trauma caused by the Siheung 8 Dungeon. After losing their SS-Ranked Awakened named Nicole Thompson, they became very sensitive about deploying hunters overseas. The Australian case also had active lobbying from the Senator, but the administration didn’t approve it.
“You reasoned that you didn’t hear anything from me, didn’t you? That it was an independent plan that Seo Jin-Wook pushed through.”
The Senator already knew all the recent events since he heard of it from me.
“That’s what I said, but it’s not like they believe me. I think I need to go to Korea soon.”
“To meet me?”
“Yes! They want me to meet you in person and persuade you to include the U.S. in the future when you do business with the aliens.”
Sending a person in command of lobbyists who mainly targetted U.S. senators to South Korea meant that I had become the target of lobbying that time around.
I quietly snorted.
“Thanks to you, I’m being treated too well. Still, you don’t have to follow the government’s orders necessarily, do you? It’s not like they hired you either.”
“It’s all for show. I’ll need to pretend to run the errand they assigned me to. If I aggravate my relationship with the administration, it’ll make things difficult to work in the future. It’s better to move while their tone is still in the ‘favor’ or ‘request’ stage.”
He spoke in a way that told me he would endure the brief discomfort to lubricate the relationship.
Even if we met, he didn’t expect me to be tolerant of the U.S. government. He already knew me enough to be aware of that. It would be nothing but a show.
“Should I schedule it for you, then? I’ll have some accommodations prepared over here.”
“Let the staff take care of it. That aside, there’s one more reason why I contacted you today.”
Senator’s expression darkened a bit.
“At the same time as the White House heard the news… No, perhaps even a little faster, it seems that they received the same information in Beijing.”
“I see.”
“As you know, China didn’t send a hunter to Australia, and they’re in a position where they can’t even take the crumbs.”
There was no particular reason for their refusal to dispatch a hunter, but that was their national policy.
China’s number of Awakened was estimated to be between 500,000 to 600,000. They were drafted as soon as they Awakened. Unless it was a very exceptional case, the Awakened beings weren’t sent abroad, and vice versa. It was extremely rare for them to ask for help from other countries. There were enough Awakened to cover all of their vast territories, after all.
“The U.S. is struggling with their lost pride and is still trying to use conciliatory measures. They’re using utilizing me to coax you. However, China is in a different position.”
His eyes deepened.
“The Communist Party has managed to overcome the rebellion with internal propaganda and politics of fear, which they claim to be coping best after the Cataclysm. In this situation, it would be a terrible nightmare for the leadership if there is an objective indicator that China has been excluded from the mainstream. They’re already in a state where they had taken a blow because of J/V’s mass-produced artifacts.”
That deal was a revolutionary opportunity to turn the world’s industries upside down once again, and it would be hard to hide the fact that they missed it. There had to be limits to controlling the country’s media, and rumors would eventually spread among the people.
I nodded in agreement.
“They’d be more desperate to join the trade than the United States.”
“But then it seems like those crazy bastards don’t plan on lobbying or negotiating.”
I roughly understood what he meant.
“The real key to the deal is an Awakened, right? I’m talking about you, you.”
“They would think it’s simpler and easier to snatch a single person and put them under their disposal than to work hard to please and negotiate with others.”
The Senator contacted me to warn me about that.
“Yes, you better be careful. They might do something more than what you’re expecting.”
*
China, Beijing.
In one conference room, intelligence agencies and commanders of the People’s Liberation Army Special Brigade put their heads together.
The hologram in the center showed a picture of a young man.
The Guild Master of Celestial Dragon, Seo Jin-Wook.
“The leadership is in a terrible mood.”
A groan spread among the participants. The official who presided over the meeting made eye contact with them one by one as he spoke.
“The order has already been made.”
He pointed at Seo Jin-Wook in the hologram.
“There’s also information that the mass-produced artifacts that started deliveries to the UN are deeply related to that Awakened.”
The party leadership’s biggest concern was that the gap would become so vast that they wouldn’t be able to catch up.
Although many industrial spies were dispatched to the U.S. and South Korea, they couldn’t extract critical technologies. As a desperate measure, they stole the actual supplies from the U.N. military and handed them over to their laboratory. Still, Chinese scientists couldn’t even comprehend the operating principles of essential parts, let alone the effect’s reproduction.
“That man is also deeply involved in the unprecedented success of trade with the aliens.”
The information was leaked out by a hunter from another country that was involved in the Australian dungeon exploration.
From the leadership’s perspective, they must’ve felt like they were being punched consecutively.
“One more thing.”
The screen changed.
It showed a Gate 30km away from central Beijing.
Occupied by the Botarch species and wholly locked in with barricades before, it was devastated by giant worms, and the restoration work was already in progress.
“The survivors from that place had strange testimonials.”
The general, a member of a unit composed of Awakened, raised a question.
“You mean the ones who fell over the barricade?”
Everyone remembered that event in their heads.
Due to the power gap against the Botarch, the Chinese army couldn’t recover the land the aliens had been occupying for a long time, and thousands of hostages held inside couldn’t be rescued. Even when they dispatched special forces composed of Awakened beings to infiltrate one after another, only grim news of annihilation returned.
There were a sudden uproar and earthquake beyond the barricade, and an incident occurred that made everyone surrounding the area question their visions.
People poured down from the sky like rain.
“They said they were in a gym, and suddenly, thousands of giant tentacle-like things appeared and wrapped around them to throw them out.”
At that time, Adam took over instead of Seo Jin-Wook, who went to the Botarch dimension.
He turned a part of his body into a giant octopus-like creature then threw the picked-up hostages over the wall. The soldiers, who saw them pouring down from the sky, expected a devastating fall that wouldn’t even leave their bodies intact, much less their lives.
However, the scene that immediately took place afterward was also unexpected. Adam, who had to avoid allegations of non-Awakened Genocide and had to cooperate with Seo Jin-Wook, made them land slowly as if wearing parachutes by making the octopus suckers on their bodies swell up one by one.
Due to heart attacks and other reasons, a bit of casualty was sustained, but it wasn’t enough to destroy a good outcome.
However, there was a strange testimony among the escapees who testified that they had seen the octopus monster.
“A story that a Western man was standing at the center of it all, and whose height was more than three meters, came from multiple hostages.”
There was only one hunter on Earth that matched that physical description.
“Adam Abrams!”
“Yes, he also belongs to the Celestial Dragon– the very guild that Seo Jin-Wook worked at as its Guild Master.”
“You’re saying that the Celestial Dragon was involved in the events of that day? But how can they solve something that our special forces couldn’t?!”
“He couldn’t have won by fighting with pure force. He must have had a trick. The problem is, we don’t even know what the trick is.”
As if to organize the murmur in the conference room, a high-ranking official who convened them spoke.
“I’m sure everyone feels the same way. There is some kind of secret Seo Jin-Wook and the Celestial Dragon are hiding. Technology that no one knew, trading methods, and how to deal with invading aliens came out of one person’s head? It’s not a level that could be interpreted as simply being a genius or having good luck.”
The party leadership has already ordered Seo Jin-Wook to be recruited. Since the Head had issued a command, the roles of the hands and feet that would carry it out belonged to the people gathered here.
“But kidnapping an SS-Class hunter will be very difficult. There is also an unconfirmed intelligence that the British side has already tried once and failed. If that’s true, he must be on high alert.”
“With the hunter’s recommendation that explored the Australian Dungeon together, the World Hunter Association is already preparing for the SSS-Rank certification of Seo Jin-Wook. By the level of force observed, he should already be considered an SSS-Rank.”
“How about the usual method? We will take a hostage.”
“The father, his only immediate family member, is also S-Rank, and we can’t find his track record at the moment.”
“Hmm, if the hostage option is also unavailable…”
The intelligence agent contemplated for a while before continuing.
“No matter how you think about it, it’s impossible to capture a target as big as Seo Jin-Wook in a foreign country without leaving a trace.”
“Then why don’t we turn the stage into our own country?”
“That would be much more advantageous. An even better environment than that would be inside the open Gates in our territory.”
As he nodded-
“Then we have an answer. We’ll have to lure him into Chinese territory somehow.”
“But are you sure he would willingly come in?”
“When it comes to baiting the Awakened, there’s a way that works almost without fail.”
The screen changed with the man’s words, and all the participants who looked at it nodded in agreement.
*
“Guild Master! You need to look at the news!”
When Secretary Kim suddenly opened the door and came in, I was on the phone with the minister of the Hunter Management Department. After showing a gesture that covered my lips with a finger, I concluded the call.
Meanwhile, Secretary Kim kept looking at me with a restless expression.
“…!”
His eyes were trembling profusely.
“Yes, thank you. I will contact you soon.”
As soon as I hung up the phone…
“Here, look at the news!”
He put up a huge hologram on the screen. It was a breaking news report. There were subtitles with provocative keywords, and my name was mentioned.
“An SS-Class dungeon has been found in China!”
“I know. I was just talking about it on the phone.”
The Chinese government broke their precedent behavior and made a surprise announcement. They claimed that an SS-Class dungeon was found within their territory and that its status was identified as ‘slightly unstable.’
It was strange that those who hadn’t leaked any information on how many Gates existed in their own country, how many hunters were in each grade, and the dungeon Clears’ statuses suddenly acted like that.
And there was one more unconventional action.
“To increase the success rate of dungeon exploration, they would like to invite other SSS-Class hunters and their equivalent to China. It’s like the Siheung 8 Dungeon or the Australian dungeon! And they said they had prepared tremendous rewards for those who participate.”
It wasn’t an action that China, which had been snobbish, would take.
That meant that the government was that desperate… Or that they were aiming for the equally great opposition pay wherein they could lower their opponents’ self-esteem a bit.
Their intention was obvious.
‘They’re very bold.’
A Chinese government official who appeared on TV was reading the statement with a confident look.
-… To that, the People’s Republic of China asks the world’s leading hunters for cooperation based on humanity. China’s Foreign Ministry has already sent separate invitations via governments….
The Internet was flipped. The overall response was that they were brazen to suddenly ask for help when they never cared about whether the situation in other countries had been chaotic or messy.
Another news that provoked the people was that China handpicked elite hunters from each country and sent invitations.
“And my name was mentioned among them.”
While the hologram floated in front of Secretary Kim, a diplomatic document from China was received and delivered by the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
“Are you… going to accept it? You know how notorious they are!”
“Yes, I’m thinking of going.”
I could vividly see the Senator running wild, but I didn’t want to hide and avoid them just because they pushed in so blatantly.
“Should I say, it’s like killing two birds with one stone? It’s great.”
“What?”
Secretary Kim, who didn’t understand my words, looked puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 115
chapters.content:
A Dangerous Invitation (2)
The Chinese government press conference began at 11 a.m. based on Korean time and most people watching the video live expressed their negative views regarding the contents of the conference.
– LMAO, the more I think about it, the more ridiculous it gets. Has China ever dispatched Awakened to another country when they called for help?
↳ Never except for that time they sent them to E or F-Class dungeon just to show off what they can do.
– But isn’t it rare to set up a multinational ace team in the first place and treating that dungeon in the same level as Siheung or Australia?
↳ They were both S-Class dungeons. In the case of C or D-Class, there are quite a few cases where people request help from foreign countries because countries with small populations cannot handle it by themselves. However, China isn’t one of those countries. They don’t need to set up an ace team, so pleading to send a few…
↳ Yup, and China has no history of sending aid to other countries in the first place.
– Based on what they’ve said so far, I can tell that they’re such a cunt… What makes them think other countries will send their hunters over to help them when they won’t even do the same?
↳ There’s just absolutely no way they would send SSS-Rank hunters as requested by China. It wouldn’t be beneficial for them.
↳ Even the Chinese would’ve questioned their decision. I think everyone will dispatch hunters below SS-Rank, then they’ll pressure China to fill up the shortage of workforce before entering the dungeon.
However, the reactions began to change due to the subsequent interviews. The Chinese spokesman was being interpreted simultaneously in each country.
– Oh, you just saw it? All foreign hunters who accepted the invitation will be given a core equivalent to 100,000 Mana storage.
It was announced that the cores, which were strictly prohibited from being transferred overseas in most countries, would be rewarded as compensation, and the rules would be lifted for that case.
– How many hundred billion won is that? Come on. It’s a little weak. Let’s demand more.
– Isn’t that just a couple hundred billion in the end? Come on, that’s a bit cheap. They should prepare more.
As if to meet expectations, the spokesman continued.
“And we plan to check the contribution rate among the ‘foreign hunters’ who participated in the dungeon exploration and give the artifacts separately prepared by the Chinese government to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd top contributors. The item will be used by Chinese hunters while exploring the dungeon. However, it’ll be distributed according to their contribution after the end of the Clear.”
The response wasn’t good until that story came out.
– LMAOOO, is this a prize of some sort? it’s a ridiculous idea.
– They must be relaxed after joining the ‘Murican club, huh?
However, the atmosphere changed in an instant when the spokesperson uploaded an evidence video.
– Oh, my God, there was an item like that?! That would make even the eyes of SSS-Rank hunters turn their eyes over!
It was a product prepared by China for invited hunters.
The Bracelet for third place was an S-Rank artifact that significantly increased defense power when equipped.
The SS-Rank item to be given to the second place was a magic sword, which had ten built-in S-Rank attack spells, allowing even untrained Awakened to use magic for as long as they injected Mana into it.
Both of them were meaningless items for Seo Jin-Wook and his group, but those rewards were enough to surprise other hunters.
-Oh my, look at the 1st place item.
Lastly, there was the 1st place prize that caught people’s attention around the world.
The content that was already identified by the Analysis scroll was disclosed to the media.
[Scepter of Ishad (Rank: SSS)]
– Item description: A scepter that can be equipped with seven properties rune stones. 40% reduction in spell casting speed and 35% reduction in Mana consumption during magic skill activation, full immunity to A-Rank or below abnormal-condition-materialization skills, 30% increase in magic resistance, and alleviation of potion shock symptom effect while in hand.
Everyone went wild.
-That’s crazy. It’s an SSS-Rank item!
*
“Guild Master Seo Jin-Wook, I plead you. Please reconsider!”
The Hunter Management Department persistently contacted me even after I hung up once and tried to reverse my choice.
When Secretary Kim came in, I had already delivered my statement to them.
I said that I’d accept the Chinese government’s invitation but that I wanted to put a condition on it.
I said that instead of just me, who was invited, Hibiki and Nate would accompany me.
“Minister, you don’t have to worry too much. I have a plan.”
“Guild Master, we are more concerned about China than about Dungeon monsters! And considering what will be announced at 3 o’clock in a little while, the national sentiment will be…!”
But they couldn’t bend my stubbornness in the end.
And after hours have passed since the Chinese government’s announcement, another shocking news swept the world’s media.
– Wow, I can’t take my eyes off the news all day!
– Is today some special day? LOL. I can’t get my head around it. Chinese SS-Class dungeons in the morning, Australian aliens in the afternoon?
-… Huh? Seo Jin-Wook’s picture is up. No way. Is he going to do it again in a while?
It was none other than news of an incident in the Australian dungeon.
– Oh, my God, Seo Jin-Wook is the most significant contributor… To the success of trading with aliens?!
↳ Did you just see the interview with the Italian hunter? The aliens boldly said that they want to keep talking to Seo Jin-Wook. LOOOOL.
↳ Woah, a man who even woos aliens. He’s got some class!
↳ So without Seo Jin-Wook, people on Earth can’t trade with them at all?
↳ Mmhmm, it seems so in this situation.
Then, naturally, people that interpreted the two shocking news stories in the morning and afternoon in relation to each other appeared.
– Wait, isn’t China going to invite Seo Jin-Wook?
↳ Isn’t Seo Jin-Wook still SS-Rank?
↳ Come to think of it. The announcement was a little weird. Why did they vaguely refer it to ‘hunters equivalent to SSS-Rank’? Instead of setting the bar to SSS-Rank. This is surely… because they kept Seo Jin-Wook in mind!
↳ Shouldn’t we stop Seo Jin-Wook? What if things go south?
The public opinion prevailed that I shouldn’t go, but I made my official statement through the Celestial Dragon Public Relations Team a few days later.
I publicized that I understood the people’s concerns, but I judged that China’s SS-Rank dungeon was a threat to Korea, as it was nearby, and that I would do my best to contribute to our country’s safety.
Soon after, the day suggested by the Chinese government arrived.
*
“Share quest.”
Paht!
– Quest Name: Verification of Qualification (1)
– Description: To climb the Tower of Choice, you must prove your qualification as a worthy Awakened. Successfully Clear an SS-Class dungeon in your world and secure more than 20% of the contribution rate.
– Rewards: from 1 million experience points based on contribution.
– This quest can also be shared with non-chosen.
“Huh?”
“… Something new really appeared.”
The eyes of Hibiki and Nate stared into space.
They’re looking at the system message that had just appeared.
“I shared the quest with you guys just now.”
In my eyes, I could see all the quests that the Earth’s chosen Awakened could perform. In total, there were over 100. It’s supposed to be done by several people simultaneously, so it was normal to reach that number.
However, Hibiki and Nate, who hadn’t been chosen yet, could only see the quests I shared.
“Now, then… Shall we talk?”
I explained it to both of them. To end the tutorial quest, we had to climb the structure called the Tower of Choice, and that I was thinking of the three of us as the members.
‘In my past life, five people climbed up.’
However, Randy was still a child who hadn’t even entered elementary school, and Angelica was already dead.
‘There was no entrants restriction on the tower. One person or even a hundred people can enter.’
The problem was that the difficulty scaled according to the number of entrants.
Five people entered back in my previous life, but only four people fought since I had no battle capability.
We conducted a lot of experiments on the lower floors of the tower at that time before proceeding to climb with the finalized five members of the chosen party.
“When the time comes for the Tower of Choice to be summoned, other countries will not be able to interfere since we will be the only ones who would have earned the qualification to climb the tower.”
I asked them a question, speaking until up to that point.
“What do you think? If there is a question or some part that you don’t like…”
It was after I told them almost everything except that I had reincarnated and that Adam was an alien.
I had told them detailed information such as what would happen in the Tower of Choice and what would happen after the tutorial.
It was not an ordinary dungeon, but they would be placed in a situation where they had to risk their lives to climb a 100-story tower, so I gave them a choice rather than just ordering them to come.
But…
“Why did you feel the need to ask us that?”
Nate replied indifferently to my question.
“This is also a part of the plan that you, Jin-Wook, spoke of, right? That thing to keep the world from being doomed.”
“Yup.”
“Then it’s fine with me no matter what you want us to do. You don’t have to ask me every time from now on.”
Hibiki’s reaction was the same as his.
“I’ll come with you as well.”
I thanked them for the trust they showed before continuing with my thoughts.
“Well, let’s go earn that qualification to climb. Time to go to China.”
*
The Chinese government’s unusual behavior continued. They finally revealed their Gates to foreign media for the first time.
The Gate leading to the SS-Rank dungeon was located near Guangzhou in southern China.
Cha-cha-cha-cha-cha!
Everyone’s attention was concentrated in one place despite the flashing sounds of the shutters.
“Look, it’s Klaus from America! That SSS-Rank magic swordsman! How did he get permission from the U.S. government?”
“Even Dmitri of Russia and Chati of India came all the way here!”
“I’ve never seen so many SSS-Class in one place.”
People were surprised by the fact that three SSS-Class hunters accepted the invitation from China.
They were the kinds of hunters that never would have been released from their home country under normal circumstances.
“In the case of Klaus, I heard there is a rumor that he departed the country in a manner that is close to leaving without permission. It was apparently due to a serious conflict between him and the U.S. government.”
The Korean government personnel, who was moving with us, whispered to me.
I answered using an indifferent tone.
“I see. I’m sure the Chinese government’s items are very desirable to him as well, but….”
I wore a faint smile as I continued.
“Don’t you think there’s something that makes him feel safe due to my attendance?”
After hearing that, the foreign affairs official’s face was slightly blurred, but it quickly regained its original color.
He spoke in a serious tone as if to reassure me.
“If anything happens to the Guild Master’s situation, the Korean government will definitely take all measures necessary to ensure the safety of the Guild Master!”
I smiled at the thought, but I shook my head.
“Don’t worry. I can take care of myself.”
I didn’t mean anything else when I said that he ‘felt safe because of my attendance’ because rumors spread that I was the no. 1 target of the Chinese government.
I thought he had the mentality of ‘Yes, as long as it’s not me, I’m fine with it!’
Of course, some of them were skeptical about how they would dare to touch me at the risk of criticism from around the world, and others seemed to be half-sure.
It all stemmed from the suspicion that China would so boldly act that way regardless of public opinion.
It would seem that the possibility had become even lower since foreign journalists had gathered around us like that.
‘Let’s see what happens.’
Meanwhile, reporters showed explosive interest in me as well.
They shouted out loud from afar as we passed by.
“Seo Jin-Wook, please say something!”
“You’re the only SS-Class among the invited foreign hunters. How do you feel?”
“I heard you insisted that you’d be accompanied by two S-Class hunters from your guild as a condition for your participation. By any chance, is your goal to fill the contribution slots with those three people from 1st to 3rd place? Are you aiming for all the artifacts the Chinese government publicly presented as compensation?”
Awakened beings and reporters who listened to the last question together were seen smiling bitterly.
Some of them whispered among themselves.
“That fella is so mean.”
“It would be possible if the only foreigners who were invited and participated were the three from Celestial Dragon, but it’s obvious that it would be impossible under the current situation since even the SSS-Class joined the expedition.”
“Even if Seo Jin-Wook is preparing for the SSS-Class certification, why did he bring the other two S-Ranks? I’m sure there are a lot of Chinese S-Ranks as well.”
Since the Chinese government had placed a considerable distance between the Awakened individuals and the press journalists in advance, I smiled instead of answering them. Then, once again, the shutters exploded like crazy and took a picture of us doing so.
“Then, we’re entering!”
We entered the Gate at the command of the exploration team leader, General Ray Chen.
*
In terms of the exploration team composition, there was a total of 30 people, their ranks ranging from S-Rank to SSS-Rank.
There was no SSS-Rank among Chinese hunters who refused to be certified by the World Hunter Association, and the official highest level was SS-Rank.
I looked at their Mana in my spare time while proceeding with the dungeon Clear.
‘There are about 20 Chinese people who have over 30,000 Mana.’
30,000 Mana was the minimum requirement to reach the SS-Rank.
After confirming them with [The Successor’s Eyes], I couldn’t help but smile at their impudence.
‘I think even if they didn’t invite hunters from overseas and went through all that show, it would be possible to Clear the dungeon using only the Awakened Chinese people. I don’t know what monsters will come out from now on in this dungeon, though.’
I didn’t know much about the dungeon we were in because the data hadn’t been shared in my previous life.
Back then, China used its sole power to Clear and closed up the place. Of course, it was before the nation showed signs of collapse.
‘If they could have done it in my previous life, they could have done it this time. It’s just that the history has changed because of me.’
The Guangzhou dungeon was a complex dungeon that was divided into several stages.
The packs of werewolves that rushed in from all sides were helpless against the intense might of our forces. The first stage of the Clear operation continued without interruption or problems.
Chinese hunters intentionally took a step back from the frontlines in order to give the foreigners a chance to be more active, and the invited SSS-Rank Awakened didn’t refuse the consideration.
The fight over the artifacts that would serve as compensation was a competition among themselves, but they also allowed them to take the cores of the monsters they killed, so they seemed motivated enough.
The first day came to an end like that. We set up camp, and the time to rest soon came.
I gave the Chinese people a look once again. Some of them stood out.
‘It’s just that they haven’t been certified yet, but only comparing the total amount of Mana, there are some in their ranks that are stronger than the invited SSS-Rank individuals.’
Among them, a hunter, who was approaching me with a stiff smile at that very moment, was an exemplary case.
“Guild Master Seo Jin-Wook?”
It was Ray Chen, the Chinese soldier who led the expedition.
“Can we talk for a moment if you don’t mind?”
It had finally begun.
I got up from my seat with a smile.
“Of course.”

chapters.title: Chapter 116
chapters.content:
A Dangerous Invitation (3)
General Ray Chen was a man who appeared to be in his early 30s, making his youthful appearance compared to the stars completing his rank badge seemed out of place.
No matter how one could be Awakened, it wasn’t easy to climb up to the position he sat on. The secret was wriggling in Ray Chen’s heart.
‘42,000 Active Mana, huh… a little under Hibiki’s prime.’
He was one of the many Awakened that I wasn’t aware of in my previous life. In the course of China’s collapse, his life probably ended and disappeared without being adequately documented in history.
“Guild Master, don’t you have a lack of ration or water?”
He asked me that question in a calm tone as he walked with me. Like us, foreign hunters were eating meals with the supplies they had brought themselves instead of food rationed by the Chinese military.
“We got enough. You don’t have to worry.”
“If you ever have a lack of supplies, please let me know anytime. We’ll be more than willing to provide.”
“Yes, I’ll do that.”
Of course, that would never happen.
“Hmm… I think we’re far enough to escape the ears and eyes of others at this point.”
Ray Chen stopped walking and looked at me dead in the eye.
“I know that there are bad rumors about why we invited foreign hunters to China. That seems to be especially the case about Guild Master Seo Jin-Wook.”
It was an unexpectedly direct approach.
“I heard that they’re spouting such rumors about China and its government trying to commit something mischievous and malicious against Seo Jin-Wook. They even stated that inviting other hunters is just a smokescreen operation to hide our real intentions since it would seem weird no matter what anyone thought for us to invite you alone, Guild Master.”
“…”
It was true that such a story was circulating, but I didn’t expect to hear it from one of the Chinese Awakened himself.
Ray Chen continued talking with a smile on his lips.
“I’m a soldier, and I don’t know much about diplomacy. But I can be reasonable. Those who spread such rumors insult not only my country but also you, Guild Master, who came to help us in good faith. If it’s true, you would be doing nothing short of a stupid act wherein you’re placing your feet in an obvious trap.”
He spoke in a manner that wanted to tell me his country would never plan such a despicable thing.
“It doesn’t make sense. If the Guild Master goes missing here, the whole world will blame China. I don’t know much about diplomacy, but there are countless competent and intelligent diplomats in my country. Would they approve of such a foolish plan?”
“Did you bring me here to reassure me?”
He shook his head.
“I simply wanted to thank you in a much more peaceful and quieter manner and environment. Thank you for trusting my country despite all of the speculations and slander circulating about us.”
He then took out a small box and a clump of paper in his pockets.
The Mana that fluttered around the small item was unusual.
“It’s a little sincerity that I prepared for the Guild Master who willingly came here despite the difficult situations.”
He passed the item box and the [Analysis] scroll to me.
I opened it without saying anything and checked the contents. The moment I touched it, the item description came up due to the effect of my unique skill, but I also tore the scroll to prevent him from being suspicious of me.
A message that I had already read and confirmed then appeared once again.
[Recharging Booster Ring (Rank: SSS)]
– Item description: 25% increase in physical recovery speed, 50% increase in Mana recovery potion effects when passively equipped.
I already knew what it was because of the Mana pattern, but I pretended to be shocked beyond measure to, again, avoid raising suspicions.
“… Woah! This is also an SSS-Class item!”
I didn’t forget to add a gentle tremor to the tail of my words.
When I looked at him with my jaw dropped wide enough to hurt my chin, Ray Chen gave me a satisfied smile.
“This is a special gift prepared for the Guild Master. Please, I would appreciate it if you would use this throughout the expedition. Of course, we won’t ask you to return it after the Clear.”
“… I will accept it with my deepest gratitude. This is definitely a pleasant surprise.”
“Of course, if you make into the top three contributions among foreign hunters, you will still be able to take other items as well. I look forward to your performance.”
All of the products, including the [Scepter of Ishad], which would be offered to the top contributor, were currently equipped by Ray Chen.
“… Thank you. That sounds very desirable.”
My eyes were stuck to the ring while I replied like that.
On top of the blue-Mana-layered item, which would only seem like an ordinary item, there was another layer of blood-colored Mana.
It was the trace of a unique skill.
‘Nobody would’ve been able to tell since using the [Analysis] scroll only reveals the identity of the item itself.’
The identity of the skill was unknown. At least that was the case without [The Successor’s Eyes]!
The moment I touched the ring, one more message besides the item description came up.
[Poison King’s Breath (Rank: SSS)]
– Skill Description: Creates a potent poison with no material form, no color, no fragrance, no texture, etc.
– Once poisoned by this toxin formed using Mana, the target won’t be able to heal using a standard potion. It can only be alleviated through the usage of SSS-Rank or higher detoxification items or skills.
– Toxin activation is freely controlled by the caster. It can be left asymptomatic so that the enemy doesn’t notice any signs, or the user can make it cause pain immense enough to be comparable to death without actually killing the target. Of course, it can also induce immediate death.
‘So this is Ray Chen’s unique skill!’
He had the ability to create toxic substances that were made up of Mana.
Such things couldn’t be mixed in food or water and were usually applied to artifacts.
He then recommended an action to be taken.
“Would you like to equip it now?”
“Yes.”
I put the ring on my finger without hesitation. The red Mana, which Ray Chen could see with his eyes since he was the caster, was blocked by my body’s Mana barrier and couldn’t easily seep through, causing it to hover around instead.
But if I fell asleep like that, it would definitely start to seep in.
He continued with a smile.
